.sdot.s-done   { background: var(--success); }

/* ── Step content ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.step-label { font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .09em; color: var(--text3); font-family: var(--mono); margin-bottom: 4px; }
.step-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.step-desc  { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text2); line-height: 1.55; margin-bottom: 16px; }

/* ── Radio deploy type ───────────────────────────────────────── */
.radio-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.radio-item {
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm); cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color .15s, background .15s;
}
.radio-item input[type=radio] { accent-color: var(--amber); flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 3px; }
.radio-item.selected { border-color: var(--amber); background: var(--amber-bg); }
.radio-meta .rl { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; }
.radio-meta .rd { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text2); margin-top: 1px; }

/* ── Onboarding nav ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
.setup-nav { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 16px; }
.setup-nav .btn { flex: 1; }

/* ── Metric card subtitle ────────────────────────────────────── */
.metric-sub { font-size: 9px; font-family: var(--mono); color: var(--text3); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; margin-top: 2px; }

/* ── Queue item action guidance ──────────────────────────────── */
.q-action {
  margin-top: 6px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text2); line-height: 1.5;
  padding: 6px 8px; background: var(--surface2);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm); border-left: 2px solid var(--warn);
}

/* ── Empty state ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.empty-state {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;
  text-align: center; padding: 28px 16px; gap: 8px;
}
.empty-state-icon { font-size: 32px; opacity: .35; }
.empty-state-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text2); }
.empty-state-sub   { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text3); line-height: 1.55; max-width: 240px; }
.empty-state-action { margin-top: 4px; }

/* ── Section divider ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
.sec-divider { height: 1px; background: var(--border); margin: 16px 0; }

/* ── Tooltip wrapper ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
.has-tip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
.tip-icon {
  width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--surface2); border: 1px solid var(--border2);
  color: var(--text3); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer; flex-shrink: 0; line-height: 1;
}
/* Tap/click-to-toggle popover — see _tipInit()/toggleTip(). The native
   `title` attribute this replaces needs a mouse hover, which mobile/touch
   has no equivalent for, and exposes little to assistive tech. */
.tip-popover {
  position: fixed; z-index: 200; max-width: 260px;
  background: var(--surface); color: var(--text);
  border: 1px solid var(--border2); border-radius: var(--r);
  padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.18);
}
.tip-popover[hidden] { display: none; }

/* ── Bottom sheet backdrop & sheet ───────────────────────────── */
.bs-backdrop {
  display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,.65); z-index: 100;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}
.bs-backdrop.show { display: block; animation: bsBackdropIn .18s ease; }
.bottom-sheet {
  position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 100%; max-width: 420px;
  background: var(--surface);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  /* Derived from --r (8px) rather than a hardcoded 12px so this stays in
     sync with the shared --r/--r-sm design tokens used everywhere else
     (cards, panels, popovers) — same visual size as before, just no longer
     a one-off magic number. */
  border-radius: calc(var(--r) * 1.5) calc(var(--r) * 1.5) 0 0;
  padding: 20px 20px 36px;
  max-height: 88vh; overflow-y: auto;
  z-index: 101;
  /* Restarts on every display:none → block toggle (handleArmEngine),
     giving the sheet a slide-up entrance instead of popping in place. */
  animation: bsSheetUp .22s ease;
}
@keyframes bsBackdropIn { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
@keyframes bsSheetUp {
  from { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(24px); opacity: .4; }
  to   { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); opacity: 1; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .bs-backdrop.show, .bottom-sheet { animation: none; }
}
.bs-handle {
  width: 32px; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--border2); margin: 0 auto 16px;
}

/* ── Countdown button variant ────────────────────────────────── */
.btn-countdown { animation: pulse-warn 1s infinite; }
@keyframes pulse-warn { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:.7} }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .btn-countdown { animation: none; }
}

/* ── Post-submit next-step hint ──────────────────────────────── */
.next-hint {
  margin-top: 12px; padding: 10px 12px;
  background: var(--surface2); border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  border-left: 2px solid var(--amber);
  font-size: 12px; color: var(--text2); line-height: 1.55;
  display: none;
}
.next-hint.show { display: block; }
.next-hint strong { color: var(--text); }

/* ── Vector timestamp ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.vec-meta { font-size: 10px; font-family: var(--mono); color: var(--text3); margin-top: 8px; }

/* ── Deploy log (tech detail, collapsible) ───────────────────── */
.deploy-detail {
  margin-top: 8px; font-size: 10px; font-family: var(--mono);
  color: var(--text3); max-height: 80px; overflow-y: auto; line-height: 1.7;
  display: none;
}
.deploy-detail.show { display: block; }
.deploy-detail .l-ok  { color: var(--success); }
.deploy-detail .l-warn { color: var(--warn); }
.deploy-detail .l-err  { color: var(--danger); }
.detail-toggle {
  font-size: 10px; color: var(--text3); background: none; border: none;
  cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 0; font-family: var(--mono);
  text-decoration: underline dotted;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ═══ BOOTSTRAP SCREEN ═════════════════════════════════════ -->
<div id="screen-bootstrap">
  <div class="setup-brand">
    <div class="setup-icon">🧠</div>
    <div class="setup-name">Knowledge Operating System</div>
    <div class="setup-ver">v8.0 · HEADLESS STUDIO EDITION</div>
  </div>
  <p class="setup-tagline">
    Your personal AI system learns how you work and<br>
    builds itself around your context. Usually under two minutes.
  </p>
  <div class="setup-card">
    <div id="bs-idle">
      <button class="btn btn-primary" id="btn-bootstrap" onclick="handleBootstrap()">
        <i class="ti ti-rocket"></i>Build My Studio
      </button>
      <p style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);text-align:center;margin-top:10px;line-height:1.6">
        Creates a private spreadsheet, Drive folders, and AI personas<br>in your Google account. Nothing is shared.
      </p>
    </div>
    <div id="bs-active" style="display:none">
      <div class="prog-steps">
        <div class="prog-step" id="pstep-0"><span class="p-icon">⬜</span><span class="p-label">Setting up your private workspace</span></div>
        <div class="prog-step" id="pstep-1"><span class="p-icon">⬜</span><span class="p-label">Organizing your Drive folders</span></div>
        <div class="prog-step" id="pstep-2"><span class="p-icon">⬜</span><span class="p-label">Creating your AI advisor team</span></div>
        <div class="prog-step" id="pstep-3"><span class="p-icon">⬜</span><span class="p-label">Installing background automation</span></div>
        <div class="prog-step" id="pstep-4"><span class="p-icon">⬜</span><span class="p-label">Finishing up</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="bs-done" style="display:none;text-align:center;padding:8px 0">
      <div style="font-size:28px;margin-bottom:8px">✅</div>
      <div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:6px">Your studio is ready.</div>
      <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.6">
        The system learns as you work — no configuration required.<br>
        Paste your first session log in the Ingest tab.
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="bs-err" class="toast toast-err" style="display:none;margin-top:10px" role="alert" aria-live="assertive">
      <i class="ti ti-alert-circle"></i>
      <div><div id="bs-err-msg" style="font-weight:500"></div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;margin-top:2px">Check your Google account permissions and try again.</div></div>
    </div>
    <!-- Lives outside #bs-active on purpose — a failed deploy hides
         #bs-active a second later to show the retry button, which used to
         take this technical detail (the only real diagnostic info) with
         it. Kept reachable alongside #bs-err instead, for both outcomes. -->
    <!-- Hidden until a deploy actually populates #deploy-detail below —
         this sat clickable from the very first screen a brand-new user
         sees, before "Build My Studio" had ever been clicked, opening an
         empty, oddly-spaced box with nothing in it. -->
    <button class="detail-toggle" id="detail-toggle-btn" style="margin-top:10px;display:none" onclick="toggleDeployDetail()">Show technical detail</button>
    <div class="deploy-detail" id="deploy-detail"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══ HEADER ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<header class="hdr" id="op-header" style="display:none">
  <div class="hdr-left">
    <span class="hdr-sys">knowledge operating system</span>
    <span class="hdr-name" id="hdr-name">Active Brain Trust</span>
  </div>
  <div class="hdr-right">
    <div class="status-pill">
      <span class="dot dot-unk" id="engine-dot"></span>
      <span id="engine-label" style="font-size:10px">v8.0</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<!-- ═══ TAB CONTENT ══════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<main class="content" id="main-content" style="display:none">

  <!-- ─── INGEST ─────────────────────────────────────────── -->
  <div id="tab-ingest" class="section active" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="nav-ingest" tabindex="0">

    <!-- FIXED (finding #6): same WAI-ARIA Tabs retrofit as the bottom
         nav above — role="group" only conveyed "these buttons are
         related," not that they're tabs switching a panel below them. -->
    <div class="toggle" role="tablist" aria-label="Content type">
      <button class="toggle-btn active" id="btn-type-session" role="tab" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="fields-session" tabindex="0" onclick="switchType('session')">Session Log</button>
      <button class="toggle-btn" id="btn-type-research" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="fields-research" tabindex="-1" onclick="switchType('research')">Research / Context</button>
      <!-- NEW (Say/Do Ledger kos-personal finding #1): Seven Bridges council
           verdict logging — see submitCogVerdict() (2_Ingestion_Sensors.gs). -->
      <button class="toggle-btn" id="btn-type-cogverdict" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="fields-cogverdict" tabindex="-1" onclick="switchType('cogverdict')">Cog Verdict</button>
    </div>

    <!-- Session Log fields -->
    <div id="fields-session" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="btn-type-session">
      <div class="field-group">
        <label class="field-lbl" for="session-text">Session log</label>
        <textarea id="session-text" rows="10"
          placeholder="Paste full session log here…"
          oninput="updateCount('session-text','session-count')"></textarea>
        <div class="char-count" id="session-count">0 chars</div>
        <!-- NEW (Say/Do Ledger kos-personal finding #8): the visible
             char-count updates on every keystroke, so it can't be the
             live region itself (that would announce constantly) —
             announceStatus() writes into this hidden sibling only on a
             warn-state transition (see updateCount()). -->
        <span id="session-count-announce" class="sr-only"></span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Research / Context fields -->
    <div id="fields-research" style="display:none" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="btn-type-research">
      <div class="field-group">
        <label class="field-lbl" for="research-title">Title / source</label>
        <!-- maxlength matches the server's silent 100-char truncation
             (2_Ingestion_Sensors.gs) — without this, a longer title was
             accepted, submitted, and quietly cut down with no indication
             anything was shortened. -->
        <input type="text" id="research-title" maxlength="100" placeholder="e.g. Nielsen UX Report 2024" oninput="scheduleIngestDraftSave()">
      </div>
      <div class="field-group">
        <label class="field-lbl" for="research-text">Content</label>
        <textarea id="research-text" rows="8"
          placeholder="Paste article text, data, or notes…"
          oninput="updateCount('research-text','research-count')"></textarea>
        <div class="char-count" id="research-count">0 chars</div>
        <span id="research-count-announce" class="sr-only"></span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Cog Verdict fields (Say/Do Ledger kos-personal finding #1) -->
    <div id="fields-cogverdict" style="display:none" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="btn-type-cogverdict">
      <div class="field-group">
        <label class="field-lbl has-tip" for="cogverdict-council">Council ID
          <span class="tip-icon" title="Identifies one sequestered-council review (SMP-002) — the shared stimulus document goes out to each persona as a separate Gem conversation, and every verdict submitted back under this same ID is what groups them into one COG_REGISTRY review.">?</span>
        </label>
        <input type="text" id="cogverdict-council" placeholder="e.g. SB_1234567890 — shown by Run full council review"
          oninput="scheduleIngestDraftSave()">
        <div class="char-count">Same ID for every verdict from one review — this is what groups them.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="field-group">
        <label class="field-lbl has-tip" for="cogverdict-cog">Cog
          <span class="tip-icon" title="Which persona (from CFG.PERSONAS — Architect, Auditor, Muse, Developer, Curator, Alignment) is submitting this verdict, as a separate Gemini Gem conversation outside this pipeline. Not the same thing as a Council ID, which identifies the review all of them are voting in.">?</span>
        </label>
        <input type="text" id="cogverdict-cog" list="cog-personas-list" placeholder="e.g. PERSONA_ARCHITECT"
          oninput="scheduleIngestDraftSave()">
        <datalist id="cog-personas-list">
          <? personas.forEach(function(p) { ?>
          <option value="<?= p ?>"></option>
          <? }); ?>
        </datalist>
      </div>
      <div class="field-group">
        <label class="field-lbl" for="cogverdict-status">Verdict</label>
        <select id="cogverdict-status" oninput="scheduleIngestDraftSave()">
          <option value="APPROVED">APPROVED</option>
          <option value="FLAG">FLAG</option>
          <option value="VETO">VETO</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="field-group">
        <label class="field-lbl" for="cogverdict-summary">Summary / rationale</label>
        <textarea id="cogverdict-summary" rows="6"
          placeholder="Why this cog reached this verdict…"
          oninput="scheduleIngestDraftSave()"></textarea>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Large-payload folder-drop fallback (shown when > LARGE_PAYLOAD_THRESHOLD).
         FIXED (finding #8): had no aria-live/role at all — a screen-reader
         user pasting an oversized payload got no indication this panel
         had appeared at all. Discrete, infrequent state change (shown/
         hidden once per paste, not on every keystroke), so the panel
         itself can safely be the live region — same reasoning
         showIngestToast()/showDiagStatus() already rely on for their own
         show/hide-then-set-text panels. -->
    <div id="drop-panel" class="drop-panel" role="status" aria-live="polite">
      <div class="drop-panel-title">
        <i class="ti ti-alert-triangle"></i>
        Payload too large for direct paste
      </div>
      <div class="drop-panel-body">
        <strong id="drop-char-count"></strong> — Google's proxy layer caps web app
        string transfers at ~250k chars. Use the folder-drop path instead:
        <ol class="drop-panel-steps">
          <li>
            <span class="step-num">1</span>
            <span>Open your
              <a id="inbound-folder-link" class="folder-link" href="#" target="_blank">
                <i class="ti ti-folder"></i>03.5_INBOUND_SESSIONS
              </a> folder in Drive.</span>
          </li>
          <li>
            <span class="step-num">2</span>
            <span>Create a new Google Doc inside that folder (any name).</span>
          </li>
          <li>
            <span class="step-num">3</span>
            <span>Paste your full log into the doc body and close the tab.</span>
          </li>
          <li>
            <span class="step-num">4</span>
            <span>Sensor 1 picks it up within 5 min, or run
              <strong>sensor1_scanInboundSessions</strong> manually from the editor.</span>
          </li>
        </ol>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div id="ingest-toast" class="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite">
      <i class="ti ti-circle-check"></i>
      <span id="ingest-msg"></span>
    </div>

    <!-- FIXED (Say/Do Ledger kos-personal finding #2): "processes within
         5 minutes" overstated what's actually guaranteed. Turnstile
         (10_Turnstile.gs) really does check every 5 minutes, but it can
         only hand a row off to Studio for processing — it can't complete
         one itself. Without a Studio flow connected, a row cycles
         PENDING_FLOW ↔ STUDIO_ACTIVE indefinitely, retrying forever
         rather than finishing or failing outright. Says so honestly. -->
    <div id="next-hint" class="next-hint">
      <strong>What happens now:</strong> Your session is in the queue.
      Turnstile <span class="tip-icon" title="The matrix turnstile state machine (10_Turnstile.gs) — checks the queue every 5 minutes and hands one row at a time off to Studio for processing. It can only hand off; it can't complete a row itself, which is why nothing finishes without a connected Studio flow.">?</span>
      checks it every 5 minutes and hands it to the AI engine —
      but it only actually completes once a Studio flow is connected to
      process it. Without one, it keeps retrying rather than finishing.
      Check the <strong>Queue tab</strong> to track progress — or just come back later.
    </div>

    <button class="btn btn-primary" id="btn-submit" onclick="handleSubmit()">
      <i class="ti ti-send" id="submit-icon"></i>
      <span id="submit-label">Submit</span>
    </button>

  </div><!-- /tab-ingest -->

  <!-- ─── QUEUE ──────────────────────────────────────────── -->
  <div id="tab-queue" class="section" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="nav-queue" tabindex="0">

    <div class="metric-grid" id="metric-grid">
      <div class="metric-card m-warn">
        <div class="metric-lbl">Pending</div>
        <div class="metric-val" id="cnt-pending">—</div>
        <div class="metric-sub">waiting for AI engine</div>
      </div>
      <div class="metric-card m-success">
        <div class="metric-lbl">Processing</div>
        <div class="metric-val" id="cnt-ready">—</div>
        <div class="metric-sub">in the pipeline</div>
      </div>
      <div class="metric-card m-danger">
        <div class="metric-lbl">Needs your help</div>
        <div class="metric-val" id="cnt-curator">—</div>
        <div class="metric-sub">action required</div>
      </div>
      <div class="metric-card">
        <div class="metric-lbl">Processed</div>
        <div class="metric-val" id="cnt-done">—</div>
        <div class="metric-sub">complete</div>
      </div>
      <!-- Hidden unless failed > 0 — these rows used to be silently
           excluded from every tile here, so a permanently-stuck row (e.g.
           a brand-new user's very first submission) was invisible and
           could even make the queue look empty. Only shown when relevant
           so the common zero-failures case stays uncluttered. -->
      <div class="metric-card m-danger" id="metric-failed" style="display:none">
        <div class="metric-lbl">Failed</div>
        <div class="metric-val" id="cnt-failed">—</div>
        <div class="metric-sub">couldn't be processed — see Diagnostics</div>
      </div>
      <!-- NEW (Say/Do Ledger kos-personal finding #2). Hidden unless
           counts.cycling > 0 — a PENDING_FLOW/STUDIO_ACTIVE row whose
           stale-reset count has crossed CFG.TURNSTILE_STUCK_THRESHOLD
           (3_Queue_Processor.gs's getQueueMetrics()), meaning Turnstile
           keeps handing it off but nothing is completing it. Distinct
           from "Failed" — this isn't a terminal state, just an honest
           signal that a Studio flow likely isn't connected yet. -->
      <div class="metric-card m-warn" id="metric-cycling" style="display:none">
        <div class="metric-lbl">Still waiting on Studio</div>
        <div class="metric-val" id="cnt-cycling">—</div>
        <div class="metric-sub">retrying — no Studio flow has completed it yet</div>
      </div>
      <!-- NEW: a row whose Status matches none of the recognized pipeline
           states (5_Error_And_Utilities.gs's _isKnownStagingStatus_()) —
           found via a real "AUDITING _LOG" row that was previously
           invisible in every tile here, same silent-exclusion bug the
           Failed tile above was already fixed for. Hidden unless
           counts.unknown > 0. -->
      <div class="metric-card m-warn" id="metric-unknown" style="display:none">
        <div class="metric-lbl">Unrecognized status</div>
        <div class="metric-val" id="cnt-unknown">—</div>
        <div class="metric-sub">not a known pipeline state — fix the Status cell by hand</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- NEW (external UX audit): hidden unless the Pending count has sat
         unchanged for QUEUE_STALL_MS while nonzero — the diagnostic
         USER_GUIDE.md currently asks the human to perform by eye
         ("if it stays high for more than 15 minutes, check that your
         Studio integration is running"), delivered by the app instead. -->
    <div id="queue-stall-notice" role="status" aria-live="polite" style="display:none;background:var(--warn-bg);border:1px solid var(--warn);color:var(--warn);border-radius:var(--r);padding:8px 12px;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:13px"></div>

    <div class="sec-lbl">Needs review</div>
    <!-- FIXED (finding #8): renderQueue()/_diagPanelError() both replace
         this panel's entire content on every refresh with no aria-live
         at all — refreshes every 5 min or on manual "Refresh queue"
         only, not continuously, so marking the whole panel live doesn't
         create the every-keystroke chattiness a char-count would. -->
    <div class="queue-list" id="curator-list" role="status" aria-live="polite">
      <div class="empty"><i class="ti ti-list-check"></i>Loading queue…</div>
    </div>

    <div style="margin-top:14px">
      <button class="btn btn-sm" id="btn-refresh" onclick="loadQueueStatus()">
        <i class="ti ti-refresh"></i>Refresh queue
      </button>
    </div>
    <div class="sync-line" id="queue-sync"></div>

  </div><!-- /tab-queue -->

  <!-- ─── DIAGNOSTICS ────────────────────────────────────── -->
  <div id="tab-diag" class="section" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="nav-diag" tabindex="0">

    <!-- ① CALIBRATION STATUS ─────────────────────────────── -->
    <!-- No inline margin-bottom override — .sec-lbl's own 10px default
         matches the Queue tab's "Needs review" header; these used to
         override to 8px, a stray 2px inconsistency between tabs. -->
    <div class="sec-lbl has-tip">
      Ambient calibration
      <!-- FIXED (Say/Do Ledger kos-personal finding #4): "no manual setup
           required" was true about day-to-day use (no per-session
           logging beyond your normal pastes) but false about the
           one-time setup wizard — calibration genuinely doesn't start
           until that completes (processInferenceQueue() is TIER_2,
           hard-gated cold — 1_Config_And_Deploy.gs's _coldEngineGate()).
           Narrowed to only the true claim; the state-aware note below
           (loadShadowMatrix()) carries the setup-dependent part instead
           of burying it in a hover tooltip easy to miss. -->
      <span class="tip-icon" title="The system learns your context passively from sessions — no need to log anything beyond your normal session pastes. Each question builds confidence over time.">?</span>
    </div>
    <!-- NEW (finding #4): hidden unless cold — see loadShadowMatrix(). -->
    <div id="calib-state-note" class="empty" style="display:none;padding:4px 0 8px"></div>
    <!-- FIXED (finding #8): same aria-live gap/fix as #curator-list above. -->

      <div class="empty" style="padding:8px 0">

      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sec-divider"></div>

    <!-- ② SYSTEM STATE ───────────────────────────────────── -->
    <div class="sec-lbl">System state</div>
    <!-- FIXED (finding #8): same aria-live gap/fix as #curator-list above. -->
    <div id="health-summary" style="margin-bottom:4px" role="status" aria-live="polite">
      <div class="empty" style="padding:8px 0">
        <i class="ti ti-activity" style="font-size:18px;opacity:.4"></i>Loading…
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sec-divider"></div>

    <!-- ②b CURRICULUM AUDITING (Registrar/Cog Relay) ─────── -->
    <!-- Read-only — no trigger-now/retry button here. This pipeline's
         two Studio flows (Stage 1 Auditor, Stage 2 Curator) still need to
         be built in Workspace Studio's own UI before any row can actually
         move past QUEUED_FOR_COG_1 — this panel surfaces getRegistrarStatus()
         so that's visible without opening the Apps Script editor, not a
         claim that the pipeline is fully autonomous yet. Hidden entirely
         when the ledger has never been used (total === 0) — most
         deployments won't touch this second, independent pipeline. -->
    <div class="sec-lbl has-tip" id="registrar-lbl" style="display:none">
      Curriculum auditing
      <!-- FIXED (Say/Do Ledger kos-personal finding #9): this title used
           to be static, generic text with no connection to whether the
           Stage 1/2 Studio flows this pipeline depends on are actually
           built — loadRegistrarStatus() (below) now sets it dynamically
           each refresh, self-updating once flows exist and a row
           actually completes, instead of needing a manual edit to remove
           a stale caveat later. This attribute is just the pre-JS
           fallback shown for the instant before the first load resolves. -->
      <span class="tip-icon" id="registrar-tip" title="A separate pipeline (11_Registrar_CogRelay.gs) that audits curriculum drafts for structural completeness and pedagogical dissonance — distinct from the session-log pipeline above it on this tab.">?</span>
    </div>
    <div id="registrar-summary" style="display:none;margin-bottom:4px"></div>
    <div class="sec-divider" id="registrar-divider" style="display:none"></div>

    <!-- ③ VECTOR WEIGHTS ─────────────────────────────────── -->
    <div class="sec-lbl has-tip">
      Vector weights
      <span class="tip-icon" title="How strongly each knowledge domain featured in your last processed session. Scores decay over time if a domain isn't mentioned.">?</span>
    </div>
    <!-- FIXED (finding #8): same aria-live gap/fix as #curator-list above. -->
    <div class="vec-list" id="vec-list" role="status" aria-live="polite">
      <div class="empty" style="padding:8px 0">
        <i class="ti ti-chart-bar" style="font-size:18px;opacity:.4"></i>No sessions processed yet.
      </div>
    </div>

    <div id="incubating-wrap" style="display:none;margin-top:10px">
      <div class="sec-lbl has-tip" style="margin-bottom:6px;font-size:11px">
        Incubating themes
        <span class="tip-icon" title="Emerging topics that aren't yet an established vector weight. Once a theme accumulates enough signal, it's promoted to the list above.">?</span>
      </div>
      <div id="incubating-list"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sec-divider"></div>

    <!-- ④ ACTIONS ────────────────────────────────────────── -->
    <div class="sec-lbl">Actions</div>
    <div class="diag-actions">
      <button class="btn btn-sm" id="btn-arm" onclick="handleArmEngine()" style="display:none">
        <i class="ti ti-bolt"></i>Personalize your advisor
      </button>
      <button class="btn btn-sm" id="btn-primer" onclick="handlePrimer()">
        <i class="ti ti-file-text"></i>Generate today's session starter
      </button>
      <button class="btn btn-sm" id="btn-council" onclick="handleCouncil()">

      <button class="btn btn-sm" id="btn-promote" onclick="handlePromotion()">

    <div class="sec-lbl has-tip">
      Sensor 2 webhook
      <span class="tip-icon" title="POST structured JSON here from any external tool to queue it for AI processing. Used for COG exhaust and automated council verdicts.">?</span>
    </div>
    <div class="url-box" id="webhook-url" onclick="copyWebhookUrl()"
         role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Copy webhook URL"
         onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'||event.key===' '){event.preventDefault();copyWebhookUrl();}">Loading URL…</div>
    <div class="hint">Tap to copy · POST: { cog_name, task_id, verdict, artifact_text }
      <span id="webhook-copy-confirm" style="display:none;color:var(--success);font-weight:600;margin-left:6px" role="status" aria-live="polite">✓ Copied</span>
    </div>

  </div><!-- /tab-diag -->

</main>

<!-- ── Bottom sheet backdrop (arm engine modal) ───────────────── -->
<div class="bs-backdrop" id="arm-backdrop" onclick="closeArmModal()"></div>
<div class="bottom-sheet" id="arm-sheet" style="display:none" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="arm-step-title">

    Forgotten your passphrase? You can regenerate a new Identity Key anytime — your data stays intact.
  </p>
</div>

<!-- ═══ BOTTOM NAV ════════════════════════════════════════════
     FIXED (Say/Do Ledger kos-personal finding #6): full WAI-ARIA Tabs
     pattern — role="tablist"/"tab"/"tabpanel", aria-selected,
     aria-controls/aria-labelledby, roving tabindex, Left/Right/Home/End
     key nav — wired up once by _wireTabGroup_() (see the script block),
     shared with the Ingest type-toggle below instead of each hand-rolling
     its own class-toggle logic with no ARIA at all. -->
<nav class="nav" id="op-nav" style="display:none" role="tablist" aria-label="Sections">
  <button class="nav-btn active" id="nav-ingest" role="tab" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="tab-ingest" tabindex="0" onclick="switchTab('ingest')">
    <i class="ti ti-upload"></i>Ingest
  </button>
  <button class="nav-btn" id="nav-queue" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="tab-queue" tabindex="-1" onclick="switchTab('queue')">
    <i class="ti ti-list-check"></i>Queue
  </button>
  <button class="nav-btn" id="nav-diag" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="tab-diag" tabindex="-1" onclick="switchTab('diag')">
    <i class="ti ti-activity"></i>Diagnostics
  </button>
</nav>

<!-- ═══ SCRIPT ════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<script>
'use strict';

// ── Server-injected mode (set by doGet() in 7_WebApp.gs) ───────
// Values: 'BOOTSTRAP' | 'OPERATIONAL'
// ONBOARDING mode removed — ambient shadow matrix calibrates passively.
// When loaded outside GAS (local dev), defaults to OPERATIONAL.
const SERVER_MODE = (function(){
  try { return '<?= mode ?>'; } catch(e) { return 'OPERATIONAL'; }
})();

// ── Constants ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
// GAS proxy hard-fails around 250k chars. 150k gives comfortable
// headroom for encoding overhead and occasional variance.
const LARGE_PAYLOAD_THRESHOLD = 150000;

// ── State ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let currentType  = 'session';
let currentTab   = 'ingest';
// deployConfirm/deployTimer/councilConfirm/councilTimer removed — their
// state now lives in _confirmTapState (finding #7's shared helper).
let inboundFolderUrl = null;  // cached on first load
let webhookUrl = null;        // cached on first load — immutable for the deployment's lifetime, no need to refetch every Diagnostics open

// ── GAS bridge — falls back to dev stubs when loaded outside GAS
const gsr = (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script)
  ? google.script.run : null;

function callServer(fn, args, onOk, onErr) {
  if (!gsr) {
    console.log('[DEV] ' + fn, args);
    setTimeout(() => onOk({ success: true, message: 'DEV MODE — GAS not available' }), 600);
    return;
  }
  const runner = gsr.withSuccessHandler(onOk).withFailureHandler(onErr || onServerError);
  runner[fn].apply(runner, args || []);
}

function onServerError(err) {
  console.error('[Server error]', err);
  showDiagStatus('Server error: ' + (err.message || String(err)), 'danger');
}

// ── Shared status-announcement helper (Say/Do Ledger kos-personal
// finding #8) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Matches the convention already established by showIngestToast()/
// showDiagStatus() and the two static error toasts (#bs-err/#arm-err):
// role="status"/aria-live="polite" for info, role="alert"/aria-live=
// "assertive" for anything that needs immediate attention. Written once
// so a future status-writing site gets the right announcement type by
// construction, rather than each call site independently deciding (or
// forgetting to decide) it.
function announceStatus(elId, msg, isError) {
  const el = document.getElementById(elId);
  if (!el) return;
  el.setAttribute('role', isError ? 'alert' : 'status');
  el.setAttribute('aria-live', isError ? 'assertive' : 'polite');
  el.textContent = msg;
}


// ── Tab navigation ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// ── Draft state (preserved across tab switches) ────────────────
let draftSession = '', draftResearch = '', draftResearchTitle = '';
// Cog Verdict draft state (Say/Do Ledger kos-personal finding #1). Council
// ID deliberately persists across submits (see handleSubmit()'s onOk) —
// the whole point is reusing it for every verdict from one review — while
// cog/status/summary clear after each successful submit like every other
// type's fields do.
let draftCogCouncil = '', draftCogName = '', draftCogSummary = '';
let shadowRefreshTimer = null;

// ── Queue tab auto-refresh + stall diagnostic (external UX audit) ─────────
// The Queue tab used to only refresh on tab-switch or the manual "Refresh
// queue" button, while USER_GUIDE.md told the human to manually "wait 5
// minutes and refresh" — the app already knows both halves of that
// instruction; this makes it do them instead of asking the user to.
let queueRefreshTimer = null;
// { pending, since } — tracks how long the "Pending" tile's count has sat
// unchanged, so a real stall (Studio not consuming anything) surfaces
// without waiting on a human to notice. Distinct from #metric-cycling's
// per-row Retry_Count threshold (3_Queue_Processor.gs) — that catches
// specific rows that have already retried several times; this catches the
// coarser "nothing at all has moved in a while" case, including before any
// single row's retry count crosses that threshold.
let _queueStallTracker = { pending: null, since: null };
const QUEUE_STALL_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000;

// ── Ingest draft persistence (survives refresh/accidental close) ───────────
// The in-memory draftSession/draftResearch vars above only ever survived a
// tab switch — a paste this size (up to 150k chars) is real effort to lose
// to a reload or a fat-fingered nav-back.
const INGEST_DRAFT_KEY = 'kos_ingest_draft';
function _safeLS(fn) { try { return fn(); } catch (e) { return null; } }
function persistIngestDraft() {
  if (!draftSession && !draftResearch && !draftResearchTitle &&
      !draftCogCouncil && !draftCogName && !draftCogSummary) { clearIngestDraft(); return; }
  _safeLS(() => localStorage.setItem(INGEST_DRAFT_KEY, JSON.stringify(
    { session: draftSession, research: draftResearch, researchTitle: draftResearchTitle,
      cogCouncil: draftCogCouncil, cogName: draftCogName, cogSummary: draftCogSummary })));
}
function restoreIngestDraft() {
  const raw = _safeLS(() => localStorage.getItem(INGEST_DRAFT_KEY));
  if (!raw) return;
  const d = _safeLS(() => JSON.parse(raw));
  if (!d) return;
  draftSession = d.session || '';
  draftResearch = d.research || '';
  draftResearchTitle = d.researchTitle || '';
  draftCogCouncil = d.cogCouncil || '';
  draftCogName    = d.cogName    || '';
  draftCogSummary = d.cogSummary || '';
  const st = document.getElementById('session-text');
  const rt = document.getElementById('research-text');
  const rtl = document.getElementById('research-title');
  const cc = document.getElementById('cogverdict-council');
  const cn = document.getElementById('cogverdict-cog');
  const cs = document.getElementById('cogverdict-summary');
  if (st && draftSession)   { st.value = draftSession;   updateCount('session-text','session-count'); }
  if (rt && draftResearch)  { rt.value = draftResearch;  updateCount('research-text','research-count'); }
  if (rtl && draftResearchTitle) rtl.value = draftResearchTitle;
  if (cc && draftCogCouncil) cc.value = draftCogCouncil;
  if (cn && draftCogName)    cn.value = draftCogName;
  if (cs && draftCogSummary) cs.value = draftCogSummary;
}
function clearIngestDraft() { _safeLS(() => localStorage.removeItem(INGEST_DRAFT_KEY)); }

let _ingestDraftSaveTimer = null;
function _flushIngestDraftSave() {
  clearTimeout(_ingestDraftSaveTimer);
  const st = document.getElementById('session-text');
  const rt = document.getElementById('research-text');
  const rtl = document.getElementById('research-title');
  const cc = document.getElementById('cogverdict-council');
  const cn = document.getElementById('cogverdict-cog');
  const cs = document.getElementById('cogverdict-summary');
  if (st)  draftSession       = st.value;
  if (rt)  draftResearch      = rt.value;
  if (rtl) draftResearchTitle = rtl.value;
  if (cc)  draftCogCouncil    = cc.value;
  if (cn)  draftCogName       = cn.value;
  if (cs)  draftCogSummary    = cs.value;
  persistIngestDraft();
}
function scheduleIngestDraftSave() {
  clearTimeout(_ingestDraftSaveTimer);
  _ingestDraftSaveTimer = setTimeout(_flushIngestDraftSave, 600);
}
// The whole point of this draft is guarding against an accidental close
// losing a big paste — but the 600ms debounce itself left up to 600ms of
// keystrokes unsaved if the tab closed/reloaded inside that window. Flush
// immediately on the way out instead of waiting for the timer.
window.addEventListener('pagehide', _flushIngestDraftSave);
window.addEventListener('beforeunload', _flushIngestDraftSave);

// ── Shared tab-component helper (Say/Do Ledger kos-personal finding #6)
// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Full WAI-ARIA Tabs pattern (https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/tabs/):
// roving tabindex + Left/Right/Up/Down/Home/End key navigation, layered
// on top of switchTab()/switchType()'s own existing panel-switching logic
// rather than replacing it — each keeps its own side effects (draft
// preservation, panel loads, toast clearing), _wireTabGroup_() only adds
// the keyboard mechanics, and _setTabAria_() keeps aria-selected/tabindex
// in sync with whichever tab is actually active. One implementation
// instead of switchTab()/switchType() each needing to reinvent it — this
// same convention is worth adopting for leader-hub's and cas-ccps's own
// independent tab-like patterns too (not built here — flagged only).
const NAV_TABS  = [
  { id: 'ingest', btnId: 'nav-ingest' },
  { id: 'queue',  btnId: 'nav-queue'  },
  { id: 'diag',   btnId: 'nav-diag'   },
];
const TYPE_TABS = [
  { id: 'session',    btnId: 'btn-type-session'    },
  { id: 'research',   btnId: 'btn-type-research'   },
  { id: 'cogverdict', btnId: 'btn-type-cogverdict' },
];

function _wireTabGroup_(tabs, activateFn) {
  tabs.forEach((t, i) => {
    const btn = document.getElementById(t.btnId);
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      let idx;
      if      (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') idx = (i + 1) % tabs.length;
      else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft'  || e.key === 'ArrowUp')   idx = (i - 1 + tabs.length) % tabs.length;
      else if (e.key === 'Home') idx = 0;
      else if (e.key === 'End')  idx = tabs.length - 1;
      else return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const nextBtn = document.getElementById(tabs[idx].btnId);
      if (nextBtn) nextBtn.focus();
      activateFn(tabs[idx].id);
    });
  });
}

function _setTabAria_(tabs, activeBtnId) {
  tabs.forEach(t => {
    const btn = document.getElementById(t.btnId);
    if (!btn) return;
    const active = t.btnId === activeBtnId;
    btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', active ? 'true' : 'false');
    btn.setAttribute('tabindex', active ? '0' : '-1');
  });
}

function switchTab(id) {
  // Re-tapping the tab you're already on used to reset scroll position and
  // refetch everything (queue status, diagnostics) for no reason.
  if (id === currentTab) return;

  // Preserve ingest draft before leaving
  if (currentTab === 'ingest') {
    draftSession       = document.getElementById('session-text')?.value  || '';
    draftResearch      = document.getElementById('research-text')?.value || '';
    draftResearchTitle = document.getElementById('research-title')?.value || '';
    draftCogCouncil    = document.getElementById('cogverdict-council')?.value || '';
    draftCogName       = document.getElementById('cogverdict-cog')?.value     || '';
    draftCogSummary    = document.getElementById('cogverdict-summary')?.value || '';
  }

  ['ingest','queue','diag'].forEach(t => {
    document.getElementById('tab-' + t).classList.toggle('active', t === id);
    document.getElementById('nav-' + t).classList.toggle('active', t === id);
  });
  currentTab = id;
  _setTabAria_(NAV_TABS, 'nav-' + id);
  document.getElementById('main-content').scrollTop = 0;

  // Restore ingest draft on return
  if (id === 'ingest') {
    const st = document.getElementById('session-text');
    const rt = document.getElementById('research-text');
    const rtl = document.getElementById('research-title');
    const cc = document.getElementById('cogverdict-council');
    const cn = document.getElementById('cogverdict-cog');
    const cs = document.getElementById('cogverdict-summary');
    if (st  && draftSession)       { st.value  = draftSession;       updateCount('session-text','session-count'); }
    if (rt  && draftResearch)      { rt.value  = draftResearch;      updateCount('research-text','research-count'); }
    if (rtl && draftResearchTitle) { rtl.value = draftResearchTitle; }
    if (cc  && draftCogCouncil)    { cc.value  = draftCogCouncil; }
    if (cn  && draftCogName)       { cn.value  = draftCogName; }
    if (cs  && draftCogSummary)    { cs.value  = draftCogSummary; }
  }

  // Shadow matrix auto-refresh every 5 min while on Diagnostics
  if (shadowRefreshTimer) { clearInterval(shadowRefreshTimer); shadowRefreshTimer = null; }
  // Queue auto-refresh every 60s while on Queue — mirrors the Diagnostics
  // tab's own auto-refresh above rather than leaving Queue as the one tab
  // that never re-checks itself.
  if (queueRefreshTimer) { clearInterval(queueRefreshTimer); queueRefreshTimer = null; }
  if (id === 'queue') {
    loadQueueStatus();
    queueRefreshTimer = setInterval(loadQueueStatus, 60 * 1000);
  }
  if (id === 'diag')  {
    loadDiagnostics();
    shadowRefreshTimer = setInterval(loadShadowMatrix, 5 * 60 * 1000);
  }
}


// ── Ingest — type toggle ───────────────────────────────────────
function switchType(type) {
  currentType = type;
  document.getElementById('btn-type-session'   ).classList.toggle('active', type === 'session');
  document.getElementById('btn-type-research'  ).classList.toggle('active', type === 'research');
  document.getElementById('btn-type-cogverdict').classList.toggle('active', type === 'cogverdict');
  _setTabAria_(TYPE_TABS, 'btn-type-' + type);
  document.getElementById('fields-session'   ).style.display = type === 'session'    ? 'block' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('fields-research'  ).style.display = type === 'research'   ? 'block' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('fields-cogverdict').style.display = type === 'cogverdict' ? 'block' : 'none';
  clearIngestToast();
  hideDropPanel();
  // A stale "your session is in the queue" hint used to stay visible after
  // switching to an unrelated form (e.g. Research/Context) — it only ever
  // got hidden by a subsequent submit, never by leaving the type it was
  // about.
  document.getElementById('next-hint').classList.remove('show');
  // hideDropPanel() above unconditionally hid it — switching Session Log →
  // Research → Session Log again with an oversized paste still sitting in
  // the textarea left it hidden (and stuck that way until the user typed
  // again or hit Submit, both of which independently re-check length).
  // Re-running updateCount() re-derives the correct state immediately.
  if (type === 'session') updateCount('session-text', 'session-count');
}

// FIXED (Say/Do Ledger kos-personal finding #8): tracks the last-announced
// warn state per char-count field so announceStatus() below only fires on
// an actual state *transition* (entering/leaving "too large"/"approaching
// limit"/"below minimum"), not on every keystroke — the visible count
// updates constantly, but a live region announcing every single keystroke
// would be unusable noise for a screen-reader user.
const _lastCharState = {};

function updateCount(textareaId, countId) {
  const raw = document.getElementById(textareaId).value;
  const n   = raw.length;
  // handleSubmit()/the server both validate trim().length, not the raw
  // length — a whitespace-heavy paste (leading/trailing blank lines, etc.)
  // used to show a passing counter here and then still bounce at Submit.
  const trimmedLen = raw.trim().length;
  const el  = document.getElementById(countId);
  const fmt = n.toLocaleString() + ' chars';
  scheduleIngestDraftSave();

  // Same floor submitLessonContext()/submitExternalData() actually enforce
  // server-side — surfaced here so a too-short paste is caught before
  // Submit, not after, in a round-trip error toast.
  const minLength = currentType === 'session' ? 50 : 20;

  let state, announceMsg;
  if (n > LARGE_PAYLOAD_THRESHOLD) {
    state = 'too-large';
    el.innerHTML = '<span class="char-warn"><i class="ti ti-alert-triangle" style="font-size:11px"></i> ' + fmt + ' — too large for direct paste</span>';
    if (currentType === 'session') showDropPanel(n);
    announceMsg = fmt + ' — too large for direct paste. Use the folder-drop option below.';
  } else if (n > LARGE_PAYLOAD_THRESHOLD * 0.8) {
    state = 'approaching';
    el.innerHTML = '<span class="char-warn">' + fmt + ' · approaching limit</span>';
    hideDropPanel();
    announceMsg = fmt + ', approaching the paste limit.';
  } else if (n > 0 && trimmedLen < minLength) {
    state = 'short';
    el.innerHTML = fmt + ' <span style="color:var(--text3)">· minimum ' + minLength + '</span>';
    hideDropPanel();
    announceMsg = fmt + ', below the ' + minLength + '-character minimum.';
  } else {
    state = 'normal';
    el.textContent = fmt;
    hideDropPanel();
    announceMsg = 'Back to a normal length.';
  }

  // Only announce on an actual state transition, not every keystroke —
  // the field starts in 'normal' with nothing announced yet, so the very
  // first keystroke of a normal-length paste correctly stays silent too.
  if (_lastCharState[countId] !== state && !(state === 'normal' && !_lastCharState[countId])) {
    announceStatus(countId + '-announce', announceMsg, state === 'too-large');
  }
  _lastCharState[countId] = state;
}

function showDropPanel(charCount) {
  const panel = document.getElementById('drop-panel');
  const countEl = document.getElementById('drop-char-count');
  if (countEl) countEl.textContent = charCount.toLocaleString() + ' chars';
  panel.classList.add('show');
  // Update folder link if we have the URL
  if (inboundFolderUrl) {
    const link = document.getElementById('inbound-folder-link');
    if (link) link.href = inboundFolderUrl;
  }
}

function hideDropPanel() {
  document.getElementById('drop-panel').classList.remove('show');
}


// ── Ingest — submit ─────────────────────────────────────────────
function handleSubmit() {
  clearIngestToast();
  document.getElementById('next-hint').classList.remove('show');

  const btn   = document.getElementById('btn-submit');
  const label = document.getElementById('submit-label');
  const icon  = document.getElementById('submit-icon');

  // Cog Verdict is a genuinely different shape (4 short structured fields,
  // no single free-text blob with a char-count/large-payload concern), so
  // it's handled as its own branch rather than folded into the
  // text/title-shaped logic the rest of this function assumes.
  if (currentType === 'cogverdict') {
    handleCogVerdictSubmit_(btn, label, icon);
    return;
  }

  const text  = currentType === 'session'
    ? document.getElementById('session-text').value.trim()
    : document.getElementById('research-text').value.trim();
  const title = currentType === 'research'
    ? document.getElementById('research-title').value.trim() : '';

  // Mirrors each server function's real minimum — submitSessionLog()
  // requires 50 chars, submitExternalData() requires 20. A shorter paste
  // used to round-trip to the server before failing on this exact check.
  const minLength = currentType === 'session' ? 50 : 20;
  if (text.length < minLength) {
    showIngestToast(
      currentType === 'session'
        ? 'Too short to be a real session log (minimum 50 characters) — paste the full session.'
        : 'Nothing to send — paste your article or data first.',
      false
    );
    return;
  }

  if (currentType === 'session' && text.length > LARGE_PAYLOAD_THRESHOLD) {
    showDropPanel(text.length);
    showIngestToast(
      text.length.toLocaleString() + ' chars — too large for direct paste. Use the folder-drop path below.',
      false
    );
    return;
  }

  // Research/Context has no folder-drop path (submitExternalData writes
  // one Doc in a single call, with no chunking) — so unlike Session Log,
  // there's nowhere to redirect the user to. Block clearly instead of
  // letting an oversized paste hit a raw, confusing failure.
  if (currentType === 'research' && text.length > LARGE_PAYLOAD_THRESHOLD) {
    showIngestToast(
      text.length.toLocaleString() + ' chars — too large to submit at once. Split it into smaller sections (under ' +
      LARGE_PAYLOAD_THRESHOLD.toLocaleString() + ' chars) and submit each separately.',
      false
    );
    return;
  }

  btn.disabled = true;
  label.textContent = 'Sending…';
  icon.className = 'ti ti-loader-2';

  const onOk = (res) => {
    btn.disabled = false;
    label.textContent = 'Submit';
    icon.className = 'ti ti-send';
    if (res && res.success) {
      // The toast is a brief confirmation; #next-hint (below) is the
      // persistent block that explains what happens next and where to
      // check on it — these used to say almost the same thing twice,
      // stacked in the same view.
      const chunks  = res.chunks || 1;
      const msgText = currentType === 'session'
        ? '✅ ' + chunks + ' chunk' + (chunks !== 1 ? 's' : '') + ' queued.'
        : '✅ Research filed and queued.';
      showIngestToast(msgText, true);
      document.getElementById('next-hint').classList.add('show');
      // Clear the form and discard the draft
      if (currentType === 'session') {
        document.getElementById('session-text').value = '';
        document.getElementById('session-count').textContent = '0 chars';
        draftSession = '';
      } else {
        document.getElementById('research-text').value  = '';
        document.getElementById('research-title').value = '';
        document.getElementById('research-count').textContent = '0 chars';
        draftResearch = ''; draftResearchTitle = '';
      }
      clearIngestDraft();
    } else if (res && res.duplicate) {
      // The pipeline did exactly what it should here (caught a resubmit of
      // already-queued content) — this used to render with the same
      // red/error toast as a genuine failure, which reads as "something's
      // wrong" when nothing is. Since the content really is already
      // queued, clear the form the same way a fresh success would instead
      // of leaving stale, already-processed text sitting in the box.
      showIngestToast('Already queued — no action needed', 'warn');
      if (currentType === 'session') {
        document.getElementById('session-text').value = '';
        document.getElementById('session-count').textContent = '0 chars';
        draftSession = '';
      } else {
        document.getElementById('research-text').value  = '';
        document.getElementById('research-title').value = '';
        document.getElementById('research-count').textContent = '0 chars';
        draftResearch = ''; draftResearchTitle = '';
      }
      clearIngestDraft();
    } else {
      showIngestToast((res && res.message) || 'Something went wrong. Try again.', false);
    }
  };

  const onErr = (err) => {
    btn.disabled = false;
    label.textContent = 'Submit';
    icon.className = 'ti ti-send';
    showIngestToast('Server error: ' + (err.message || String(err)), false);
  };

  currentType === 'session'
    ? callServer('submitSessionLog',  [text],         onOk, onErr)
    : callServer('submitExternalData', [text, title],  onOk, onErr);
}

/**
 * Cog Verdict submit path (Say/Do Ledger kos-personal finding #1) — split
 * out of handleSubmit() since the shape (4 short structured fields, no
 * char-count/large-payload concern) doesn't fit the text/title logic the
 * rest of that function is built around.
 */
function handleCogVerdictSubmit_(btn, label, icon) {
  const councilId = document.getElementById('cogverdict-council').value.trim();
  const cogName   = document.getElementById('cogverdict-cog').value.trim();
  const status    = document.getElementById('cogverdict-status').value;
  const summary   = document.getElementById('cogverdict-summary').value.trim();

  if (!councilId) {
    showIngestToast('Council ID is required — reuse the one shown by "Run full council review."', false);
    return;
  }
  if (!cogName) {
    showIngestToast('Cog name is required.', false);
    return;
  }

  btn.disabled = true;
  label.textContent = 'Sending…';
  icon.className = 'ti ti-loader-2';

  const onOk = (res) => {
    btn.disabled = false;
    label.textContent = 'Submit';
    icon.className = 'ti ti-send';
    if (res && res.success) {
      showIngestToast('✅ Verdict recorded for council ' + (res.uid || councilId) + '.', true);
      // Council ID deliberately survives the clear — the operator submits
      // several verdicts in a row under the same ID. Only the per-cog
      // fields reset.
      document.getElementById('cogverdict-cog').value = '';
      document.getElementById('cogverdict-status').value = 'APPROVED';
      document.getElementById('cogverdict-summary').value = '';
      draftCogName = ''; draftCogSummary = '';
      persistIngestDraft();
    } else {
      showIngestToast((res && res.message) || 'Something went wrong. Try again.', false);
    }
  };

  const onErr = (err) => {
    btn.disabled = false;
    label.textContent = 'Submit';
    icon.className = 'ti ti-send';
    showIngestToast('Server error: ' + (err.message || String(err)), false);
  };

  callServer('submitCogVerdict', [councilId, cogName, status, summary], onOk, onErr);
}

// `state` is true (success), false (error), or 'warn' (a duplicate — the
// pipeline behaved correctly, but it's not a fresh success either).
function showIngestToast(msg, state) {
  const el  = document.getElementById('ingest-toast');
  const txt = document.getElementById('ingest-msg');
  txt.textContent = msg;
  const cls  = state === 'warn' ? 'toast-warn' : state ? 'toast-ok' : 'toast-err';
  const icon = state === 'warn' ? 'ti-info-circle' : state ? 'ti-circle-check' : 'ti-alert-circle';
  el.className = 'toast show ' + cls;
  el.querySelector('i').className = 'ti ' + icon;
}

function clearIngestToast() {
  document.getElementById('ingest-toast').classList.remove('show');
}


// ── Queue ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function loadQueueStatus() {
  const btn = document.getElementById('btn-refresh');
  if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
  // FIXED: was the one action button left out when the loader-icon
  // pending-state convention was rolled out everywhere else — it just
  // dimmed to 45% opacity with the same static icon/label, no visual sign
  // anything was happening.
  if (btn) btn.innerHTML = '<i class="ti ti-loader-2"></i>Refreshing…';
  const list = document.getElementById('curator-list');
  list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty"><i class="ti ti-loader-2"></i>Loading…</div>';

  callServer('getQueueMetrics', [], (res) => {
    if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
    resetBtn('btn-refresh', 'ti-refresh', 'Refresh queue');
    if (!res || !res.success) {
      // FIXED: this branch and the network-failure branch below used to
      // render two different messages (one with an icon, one bare text),
      // and neither offered a Retry button — unlike every Diagnostics
      // panel, which was specifically given _diagPanelError()'s inline
      // Retry for the identical "couldn't load, tap Retry" scenario.
      _diagPanelError('curator-list', (res && res.message) || 'Could not load queue.', 'loadQueueStatus', 'ti-alert-triangle');
      return;
    }
    renderQueue(res);
    renderServiceStatus(res.managed_service);
  }, (err) => {
    if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
    resetBtn('btn-refresh', 'ti-refresh', 'Refresh queue');
    _diagPanelError('curator-list', 'Server error.', 'loadQueueStatus', 'ti-alert-triangle');
  });
}

// Managed Inference credits/subscription panel — restored per Round 3
// reconciliation (kos-personal/README.md). Renders ONLY when
// getQueueMetrics() returns a non-null managed_service object, which
// itself only happens when a deployment has explicitly opted into
// CFG.INFERENCE_MODE = 'MANAGED_SERVICE' and configured the standalone
// inference-service's URL/API key. In the default STUDIO mode, `account`
// is always null and this function hides the panel — so the default
// deployment still shows nothing vendor-billing-shaped, unchanged from
// before this restoration.
function renderServiceStatus(account) {
  let el = document.getElementById('service-status');
  if (!account) {
    if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
    return;
  }
  if (!el) {
    el = document.createElement('div');
    el.id = 'service-status';
    el.style.cssText = 'margin-top:12px;padding:10px 12px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r-sm);font-size:12px;';
    const syncEl = document.getElementById('queue-sync');
    if (syncEl) syncEl.before(el);
  }
  el.style.display = 'block';
  const tierLabel = account.subscription_tier
    ? account.subscription_tier.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + account.subscription_tier.slice(1)
    : 'Free';
  el.innerHTML =
    '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center">' +
    '<span style="color:var(--text3);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em">Managed Inference · ' + tierLabel + '</span>' +
    '<span style="color:var(--amber-light);font-family:var(--mono)">' + account.credit_balance + ' credit' + (account.credit_balance === 1 ? '' : 's') + '</span>' +
    '</div>' +
    (account.credit_balance < 20
      ? '<div style="color:var(--warn);font-size:11px;margin-top:4px">⚠ Low credits — sessions will pause when credits run out.</div>'
      : '') +
    // NEW (Say/Do Ledger kos-personal finding #3): this is the only
    // place credit balance/subscription tier is ever shown to a user.
    // The backend has real Stripe checkout routes
    // (inference-service/src/billing.js's createSubscriptionCheckout()/
    // createCreditPurchaseCheckout()), but nothing anywhere calls them —
    // no purchase/upgrade UI exists in this web app or the Sheets menu.
    // Stating that plainly here rather than letting a low-credit warning
    // imply a "buy more" option exists just off-screen. Whether this
    // billing backend should become a real self-serve feature, or stay
    // speculative scaffolding, is a separate, open product decision —
    // not resolved by this disclosure.
    '<div style="color:var(--text3);font-size:10px;margin-top:6px;line-height:1.4">' +
    'Purchasing more credits isn’t available here yet — this deployment mode isn’t set up for public self-serve use. Credits are provisioned manually by whoever runs this deployment.' +
    '</div>';
}

// Compares this poll's Pending count against the last one; shows/hides
// #queue-stall-notice based on how long it's sat unchanged while nonzero.
// A changing count (even a rising one) resets the clock — this is about
// "nothing is moving," not "the queue is long."
function _checkQueueStall(pending) {
  const el = document.getElementById('queue-stall-notice');
  if (!el) return;
  const now = Date.now();
  if (pending !== _queueStallTracker.pending || pending === 0) {
    _queueStallTracker = { pending: pending, since: now };
  }
  const stalled = pending > 0 && (now - _queueStallTracker.since) >= QUEUE_STALL_MS;
  el.style.display = stalled ? 'block' : 'none';
  if (stalled) {
    el.textContent = '⚠ Nothing has moved in 15 minutes — Studio may not be running.';
  }
}

function renderQueue(res) {
  const c = res.counts || {};
  const pending   = c.queued    ?? c.pending ?? 0;
  const active    = c.active    ?? 0;
  const inReview  = c.needs_review ?? c.needs_curator ?? 0;
  const done      = c.processed ?? 0;
  _checkQueueStall(pending);
  const failed    = c.failed    ?? 0;

  // FIXED: "Pending" (subtitle "waiting for AI engine") used to show
  // pending + active, double-counting active rows that are also shown
  // alone in "Processing" (subtitle "in the pipeline") right next to it —
  // e.g. 2 PENDING_FLOW + 3 STUDIO_ACTIVE rows displayed as "Pending: 5,
  // Processing: 3," summing the two tiles double-counts the 3 already-
  // processing rows. Each tile now shows only its own bucket.
  // NOTE: "Processing" counts both STUDIO_ACTIVE (genuinely running) and
  // FLOW_COMPLETE (finished inference, waiting on a later pipeline stage)
  // rows together (3_Queue_Processor.gs) — subtitle says "in the
  // pipeline," not "AI running now," so it doesn't overstate live activity.
  document.getElementById('cnt-pending').textContent = pending;
  document.getElementById('cnt-ready'  ).textContent = active;
  document.getElementById('cnt-curator').textContent = inReview;
  document.getElementById('cnt-done'   ).textContent = done;

  // FIXED: failed (terminal-status) rows used to be silently excluded from
  // every tile and from totalActivity below, so a permanently-stuck row —
  // even a brand-new user's very first submission — was invisible, and
  // could make the whole queue read as empty. Only shown when nonzero.
  const failedTile = document.getElementById('metric-failed');
  if (failedTile) failedTile.style.display = failed > 0 ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('cnt-failed').textContent = failed;

  // NEW (finding #2): same hidden-unless-nonzero convention as "Failed"
  // above — cycling is a subset of pending/active, not an additional
  // bucket, so it isn't added into totalActivity below.
  const cycling     = c.cycling ?? 0;
  const cyclingTile = document.getElementById('metric-cycling');
  if (cyclingTile) cyclingTile.style.display = cycling > 0 ? '' : 'none';
  const cyclingCnt = document.getElementById('cnt-cycling');
  if (cyclingCnt) cyclingCnt.textContent = cycling;

  // NEW: unlike cycling above, an unknown-status row is NOT a subset of
  // pending/active/etc. — it isn't counted in any of them (see
  // getQueueMetrics()'s catch-all, 3_Queue_Processor.gs), so unlike
  // cycling it DOES need adding into totalActivity below, or a queue
  // holding only unrecognized-status rows would read as empty — the
  // exact "empty queue" bug the FIXED note on "Failed" above already
  // closed for terminal-failure rows.
  const unknown     = c.unknown ?? 0;
  const unknownTile = document.getElementById('metric-unknown');
  if (unknownTile) unknownTile.style.display = unknown > 0 ? '' : 'none';
  const unknownCnt = document.getElementById('cnt-unknown');
  if (unknownCnt) unknownCnt.textContent = unknown;

  const list = document.getElementById('curator-list');
  const rows = res.needs_curator || [];

  const totalActivity = pending + active + inReview + done + failed + unknown;

  if (totalActivity === 0) {
    // True empty state — brand new user
    list.innerHTML =
      '<div class="empty-state">' +
      '<div class="empty-state-icon"><i class="ti ti-inbox"></i></div>' +
      '<div class="empty-state-title">Your queue is empty</div>' +
      '<div class="empty-state-sub">Ready to process your first session. Paste a session log in the Ingest tab to get started.</div>' +
      '<div class="empty-state-action"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" onclick="switchTab(\'ingest\')" style="width:auto;padding:8px 16px"><i class="ti ti-upload"></i>Go to Ingest</button></div>' +
      '</div>';
  } else if (rows.length === 0) {
    list.innerHTML =
      // FIXED: was ad hoc inline sizing (20px/.5 icon, 13px title) matching
      // neither the shared .empty-state-icon/.empty-state-title defaults
      // (32px/.35, 14px) nor the smaller inline-loading-icon convention
      // used elsewhere — flipping between this and the "queue is empty"
      // state below made the icon/title visibly shrink and brighten for
      // no reason.
      '<div class="empty-state" style="padding:16px 0">' +
      '<div class="empty-state-icon"><i class="ti ti-circle-check"></i></div>' +
      '<div class="empty-state-title">Nothing needs your attention</div>' +
      '</div>';
  } else {
    list.innerHTML = rows.map(r => {
      const retries  = r.retries || 0;
      const badgeCls = retries >= 2 ? 'badge-danger' : 'badge-warn';
      const docLink  = r.url && r.url !== 'undefined'
        ? '<a href="' + esc(r.url) + '" target="_blank" class="ext-link"><i class="ti ti-external-link"></i>Open doc</a>'
        : '<span class="badge" style="opacity:.4">No URL</span>';
      return '<div class="queue-item">' +
        '<div class="q-uid">' + esc(r.uid) + '</div>' +
        '<div class="q-meta"><span class="badge ' + badgeCls + '">' +
          (retries >= 2 ? '⚠ ' : '') + retries + ' retr' + (retries === 1 ? 'y' : 'ies') +
        '</span>' + docLink + '</div>' +
        '<div class="q-action">Open the doc → replace the body with your AI session\'s JSON output → the engine retries automatically within 10 minutes.</div>' +
        '</div>';
    }).join('');
  }

  const sync = document.getElementById('queue-sync');
  if (sync) sync.textContent = 'Updated ' + _fmtSyncTime(new Date());
}

// Shared "how fresh is this" formatting — Queue's "Updated" line used to be
// a client-generated, locale-default time-only string (toLocaleTimeString)
// while Diagnostics' vec-meta showed a raw server "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"
// string a few taps away — two different date grammars for the same
// "when was this current" concept in one small app.
function _fmtSyncTime(d) {
  const date = (d instanceof Date) ? d : new Date(d);
  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) return String(d);
  return date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }) + ', ' +
         date.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' });
}


// ── Diagnostics ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
function loadDiagnostics() {
  loadShadowMatrix();
  loadHealthSummary();
  loadRegistrarStatus();
  loadVectorState();
  loadWebhookUrl();
}

// A failed Diagnostics panel used to be a dead end: the only thing that
// ever re-fired these loaders was loadDiagnostics() on tab switch, and the
// tab re-tap guard means leaving and re-entering the tab is the only way
// to trigger that — non-obvious, and impossible while already sitting on
// the tab that just failed. Every panel's failure state gets an inline
// Retry that just re-calls its own loader.
function _diagPanelError(elId, msg, retryFn, icon) {
  const el = document.getElementById(elId);
  if (!el) return;
  el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty" style="padding:4px 0">' +
    (icon ? '<i class="ti ' + icon + '" style="font-size:18px;opacity:.4;margin-right:4px"></i>' : '') +
    esc(msg) +
    ' <button onclick="' + retryFn + '()" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline" style="margin-left:6px;padding:2px 10px;font-size:11px;display:inline-block;width:auto">Retry</button></div>';
}

// ── Shadow Matrix display ───────────────────────────────────────
function loadShadowMatrix() {
  callServer('getShadowMatrixStatus', [], (res) => {
    const el = document.getElementById('shadow-matrix-list');
    if (!el) return;
    if (!res || !res.success) {
      _diagPanelError('shadow-matrix-list', (res && res.message) || 'Shadow matrix unavailable.', 'loadShadowMatrix', 'ti-alert-triangle');
      return;
    }
    const modeColors = { CALIBRATED:'dot-armed', LEARNING:'dot-cold', COLD:'dot-unk' };
    const dot = document.getElementById('engine-dot');
    const lbl = document.getElementById('engine-label');
    if (dot) dot.className = 'dot ' + (modeColors[res.engine_mode] || 'dot-unk');
    if (lbl) lbl.textContent = friendlyEngineMode(res.engine_mode);

    // NEW (finding #4): state-aware note replacing the tip-icon's old
    // blanket "no manual setup required" claim — true once armed, false
    // before the one-time setup wizard has run.
    const stateNote = document.getElementById('calib-state-note');
    if (stateNote) {
      if (res.engine_armed) {
        stateNote.style.display = 'none';
      } else {
        stateNote.style.display = '';
        stateNote.innerHTML = '<i class="ti ti-info-circle" style="font-size:14px;opacity:.5;margin-right:4px"></i>' +
          'Calibration hasn\'t started — finish the one-time setup wizard below to activate it.';
      }
    }

    el.innerHTML = res.questions.map(q => {
      const pct    = Math.round(q.confidence * 100);
      const barCol = q.status==='VERIFIED' ? 'var(--success)' : q.status==='HYPOTHESIZED' ? 'var(--amber)' : 'var(--text3)';
      const badge  = q.status==='VERIFIED' ? 'badge-ok' : q.status==='HYPOTHESIZED' ? 'badge-warn' : 'badge-gray';
      return '<div class="vec-row" style="margin-bottom:10px">' +
        '<div class="vec-hdr">' +
        '<span class="vec-name" style="font-size:11px">' + esc(q.label) + '</span>' +
        '<span class="badge ' + badge + '" style="font-size:9px">' + esc(friendlyShadowStatus(q.status)) + ' · ' + pct + '%</span>' +
        '</div><div class="bar-bg"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:' + pct + '%;background:' + barCol + '"></div></div>' +
        (q.inferred ? '<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:2px;font-family:var(--mono)">' + esc(q.inferred.substring(0,60)) + (q.inferred.length>60?'…':'') + '</div>' : '') +
        '</div>';
    }).join('');
    // Gate on engine_armed (has completeOnboarding() actually run?), not
    // all_verified (the ambient shadow matrix can fully resolve before
    // onboarding ever runs) — otherwise the only entry point into
    // onboarding can vanish while the engine is still cold.
    const armBtn = document.getElementById('btn-arm');
    if (armBtn) armBtn.style.display = res.engine_armed ? 'none' : '';
  }, (err) => {
    _diagPanelError('shadow-matrix-list', 'Couldn\'t load — ' + err.message, 'loadShadowMatrix', 'ti-alert-triangle');
  });
}


// ── Daily primer handler ────────────────────────────────────────
function handlePrimer() {
  const btn = document.getElementById('btn-primer');
  const gen = beginDiagAction();
  btn.disabled = true; showDiagStatus('Generating primer…', undefined, gen);
  // FIXED: previously only disabled the button and relied on the shared
  // status line further down the tab for any sign something was
  // happening — a user watching the button they just tapped saw it gray
  // out with no other feedback. Matches handleSubmit()/submitArmEngine()'s
  // existing loader-icon treatment.
  btn.innerHTML = '<i class="ti ti-loader-2"></i>Generating…';
  callServer('generateDailyPrimer', [], (res) => {
    btn.disabled = false;
    resetBtn('btn-primer', 'ti-file-text', "Generate today's session starter");
    if (res && res.success) {
      showDiagStatus('Daily primer saved to 03.1_CURRENT_STATE.', undefined, gen);
    } else {
      showDiagStatus('Error: ' + ((res && res.message) || 'Primer generation failed.'), 'danger', gen);
    }
  }, (err) => {
    btn.disabled = false;
    resetBtn('btn-primer', 'ti-file-text', "Generate today's session starter");
    showDiagStatus('Error: ' + err.message, 'danger', gen);
  });
}


// ── Arm Engine modal ────────────────────────────────────────────
const ARM_STEPS = [
  { label:'Step 1 of 4', title:'Your Role', validate: () => document.getElementById('arm-role')?.value.trim() ? true : 'Role is required.',
    html: `<div class="field-group"><div class="field-lbl" id="arm-dt-label">Deployment type</div><div class="radio-group" role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby="arm-dt-label">
      <label class="radio-item selected" onclick="selectDeploy(this)"><input type="radio" name="armDT" value="INDIVIDUAL" checked><div class="radio-meta"><div class="rl">Individual</div><div class="rd">Personal productivity</div></div></label>
      <label class="radio-item" onclick="selectDeploy(this)"><input type="radio" name="armDT" value="EDUCATOR"><div class="radio-meta"><div class="rl">Educator</div><div class="rd">Teaching &amp; curriculum</div></div></label>
      <label class="radio-item" onclick="selectDeploy(this)"><input type="radio" name="armDT" value="COMMERCIAL"><div class="radio-meta"><div class="rl">Commercial</div><div class="rd">Client work &amp; business</div></div></label>
      </div></div><div class="field-group"><label class="field-lbl" for="arm-role">Primary role</label><input type="text" id="arm-role" placeholder="e.g. Marketing Teacher"></div>` },
  { label:'Step 2 of 4', title:'Your Mission', validate: () => document.getElementById('arm-vision')?.value.trim() ? true : '90-Day Vision is required.',
    html: `<div class="field-group"><label class="field-lbl" for="arm-audience">Who you serve</label><input type="text" id="arm-audience" placeholder="e.g. High school students"></div>
      <div class="field-group"><label class="field-lbl" for="arm-vision">90-Day Vision</label><textarea id="arm-vision" rows="3" placeholder="What does success look like?"></textarea></div>` },
  { label:'Step 3 of 4', title:'Your Constraints', validate: () => true,
    html: `<div class="field-group"><label class="field-lbl has-tip" for="arm-ghost">Admin Ghost
        <span class="tip-icon" title="The recurring administrative busywork you want KOS to absorb for you — grading logistics, status updates, routine emails, anything that eats time without needing your judgment.">?</span>
      </label><textarea id="arm-ghost" rows="2" placeholder="What steals your time?"></textarea></div>
      <div class="field-group"><label class="field-lbl has-tip" for="arm-struggle">Necessary Struggle
        <span class="tip-icon" title="The parts of your work that matter precisely because they're effortful — thinking, relationship-building, judgment calls. KOS is designed to protect these, not automate them away.">?</span>
      </label><textarea id="arm-struggle" rows="2" placeholder="What won't you automate?"></textarea></div>` },
  { label:'Step 4 of 4', title:'Security', validate: () => {
      const p = document.getElementById('arm-passphrase')?.value;
      const c = document.getElementById('arm-passphrase-confirm')?.value;
      if (!p) return 'Passphrase is required.';
      // A single-entry field means one typo silently produces a different
      // Identity Key than the user thinks they set, discoverable only
      // later when "their" passphrase doesn't work.
      if (p !== c) return 'Passphrases don\'t match.';
      return true;
    },
    html: `<div class="field-group"><label class="field-lbl" for="arm-targets">Relational Targets</label><input type="text" id="arm-targets" placeholder="3–5 names, comma separated"></div>
      <div class="field-group"><label class="field-lbl" for="arm-passphrase">Private passphrase <span style="color:var(--danger)">★</span></label>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:6px">
        <input type="password" id="arm-passphrase" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Memorable · write it down first" style="flex:1">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" onclick="toggleArmPassVisibility()" id="arm-pass-toggle" aria-label="Show passphrase"><i class="ti ti-eye" id="arm-pass-toggle-icon"></i></button>
      </div></div>
      <div class="field-group"><label class="field-lbl" for="arm-passphrase-confirm">Confirm passphrase <span style="color:var(--danger)">★</span></label>
        <input type="password" id="arm-passphrase-confirm" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Type it again"></div>
      <div class="field-group"><label class="field-lbl" for="arm-email">Admin email</label><input type="email" id="arm-email" placeholder="your@email.com"></div>` },
];
let armStep = 0;
// Answers captured across steps within one modal session — renderArmStep()
// used to rebuild each step's HTML from scratch with no memory of anything
// typed earlier, so Continue then Back then Continue again came back blank.
let armAnswers = {};

// ── Arm-modal draft persistence (survives an accidental backdrop-click or
// Escape dismissal) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// closeArmModal() used to force-clear armAnswers/armStep unconditionally
// on every dismissal path — backdrop click and Escape both routed there —
// with zero confirmation and zero recovery: a single misclick outside this
// 4-step onboarding wizard silently wiped everything typed. Mirrors the
// INGEST_DRAFT_KEY pattern above (persist to localStorage via the same
// _safeLS() guard, restore on next open, clear only on a true
// submit-success), with one deliberate difference: passphrase and
// passphraseConfirm are never included in the persisted draft. Those are
// secrets — they have no business sitting in localStorage even briefly.
// A resumed draft just needs the passphrase re-typed, same as any
// password field left empty on a closed form.
const ARM_DRAFT_KEY = 'kos_arm_draft';
function persistArmDraft() {
  const { passphrase, passphraseConfirm, ...safeAnswers } = armAnswers;
  const hasContent = armStep > 0 || Object.values(safeAnswers).some(v => v);
