  if (!hasContent) { clearArmDraft(); return; }
  _safeLS(() => localStorage.setItem(ARM_DRAFT_KEY, JSON.stringify({ armStep, armAnswers: safeAnswers })));
}
function restoreArmDraft() {
  const raw = _safeLS(() => localStorage.getItem(ARM_DRAFT_KEY));
  if (!raw) return false;
  const d = _safeLS(() => JSON.parse(raw));
  if (!d) return false;
  armAnswers = d.armAnswers || {};
  armStep = Number.isInteger(d.armStep) ? Math.min(Math.max(d.armStep, 0), ARM_STEPS.length - 1) : 0;
  return true;
}
function clearArmDraft() { _safeLS(() => localStorage.removeItem(ARM_DRAFT_KEY)); }
// Only called after a genuine successful save (submitArmEngine) — every
// dismissal path (closeArmModal) deliberately leaves the draft in place.
function _armResetState() {
  armStep = 0;
  armAnswers = {};
  clearArmDraft();
}

let _armReturnFocus = null;
function handleArmEngine() {
  const hadDraft = restoreArmDraft();
  if (!hadDraft) { armStep = 0; armAnswers = {}; }
  _armPassVisible = false;
  // Opening never moved focus into the sheet, so keyboard/screen-reader
  // users stayed wherever they were — notionally still "on" the trigger
  // button behind the now-open sheet — and there was no keyboard
  // equivalent to the mouse-only backdrop-click dismissal.
  _armReturnFocus = document.activeElement;
  document.getElementById('arm-backdrop').classList.add('show');
  document.getElementById('arm-sheet').style.display = 'block';
  // The Tab-trap above stops keyboard focus from leaving the sheet, but a
  // screen reader's virtual cursor doesn't follow Tab order — without
  // aria-hidden/inert on the content behind the backdrop, that content was
  // still fully readable and interactive to assistive tech while visually
  // covered and inert to sighted mouse users.
  _armSetBackgroundInert(true);
  renderArmStep();
  document.addEventListener('keydown', _armEscHandler);
}

function _armSetBackgroundInert(on) {
  ['op-header', 'main-content'].forEach(id => {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) return;
    if (on) { el.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); el.setAttribute('inert', ''); }
    else    { el.removeAttribute('aria-hidden'); el.removeAttribute('inert'); }
  });
}

// skipPersist is true only right after a successful save (submitArmEngine
// already called _armResetState()) — every other caller (backdrop click,
// Escape) omits it, so the in-progress answers get captured from whatever
// is currently on screen and persisted before the sheet hides, instead of
// being force-cleared the way this function used to.
function closeArmModal(skipPersist) {
  if (!skipPersist) {
    _armCaptureStep();
    persistArmDraft();
  }
  document.getElementById('arm-backdrop').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('arm-sheet').style.display = 'none';
  _armSetBackgroundInert(false);
  document.removeEventListener('keydown', _armEscHandler);
  if (_armReturnFocus && typeof _armReturnFocus.focus === 'function') _armReturnFocus.focus();
  _armReturnFocus = null;
}

// The sheet had role/focus-in/Escape but no real Tab-trap — Tab could
// still walk focus out into the page behind the (visually blocking)
// backdrop, which a screen-reader/keyboard user would have no way to
// tell apart from the modal simply ending early.
function _armFocusables() {
  const sheet = document.getElementById('arm-sheet');
  if (!sheet) return [];
  return Array.from(sheet.querySelectorAll(
    'a[href], button:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
  )).filter(el => el.offsetParent !== null);
}
function _armEscHandler(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') { closeArmModal(); return; }
  if (e.key !== 'Tab') return;
  const focusable = _armFocusables();
  if (!focusable.length) return;
  const first = focusable[0], last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
  if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) { e.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
  else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) { e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
}

function _armCaptureStep() {
  // FIXED: g(id) used to return `undefined` outright when the element
  // wasn't in the currently-rendered step's DOM (true for every field but
  // the one(s) on whatever step is on screen right now), and Object.assign
  // copies an `undefined` property value over whatever was already stored —
  // silently wiping every earlier step's answer on each subsequent
  // transition. armDT already had the right fallback (checked ? ... :
  // armAnswers.armDT); every other field is now built the same way — fall
  // back to the previously-captured value when this step's DOM doesn't
  // have that element, instead of blindly overwriting with undefined.
  const g = (id, key) => { const e = document.getElementById(id); return e ? e.value : armAnswers[key]; };
  const checked = document.querySelector('input[name="armDT"]:checked');
  Object.assign(armAnswers, {
    armDT: checked ? checked.value : armAnswers.armDT,
    role: g('arm-role', 'role'), audience: g('arm-audience', 'audience'), vision: g('arm-vision', 'vision'),
    adminGhost: g('arm-ghost', 'adminGhost'), struggle: g('arm-struggle', 'struggle'), targets: g('arm-targets', 'targets'),
    passphrase: g('arm-passphrase', 'passphrase'), passphraseConfirm: g('arm-passphrase-confirm', 'passphraseConfirm'),
    adminEmail: g('arm-email', 'adminEmail'),
  });
}

function _armRestoreStep() {
  const set = (id, val) => { const e = document.getElementById(id); if (e && val !== undefined) e.value = val; };
  set('arm-role', armAnswers.role);
  set('arm-audience', armAnswers.audience);
  set('arm-vision', armAnswers.vision);
  set('arm-ghost', armAnswers.adminGhost);
  set('arm-struggle', armAnswers.struggle);
  set('arm-targets', armAnswers.targets);
  set('arm-passphrase', armAnswers.passphrase);
  set('arm-passphrase-confirm', armAnswers.passphraseConfirm);
  set('arm-email', armAnswers.adminEmail);
  if (armAnswers.armDT) {
    const radio = document.querySelector('input[name="armDT"][value="' + armAnswers.armDT + '"]');
    if (radio) {
      radio.checked = true;
      const group = radio.closest('.radio-group');
      if (group) group.querySelectorAll('.radio-item').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('selected'));
      const item = radio.closest('.radio-item');
      if (item) item.classList.add('selected');
    }
  }
  // Reapplies the show/hide state from toggleArmPassVisibility() — the
  // fields above were just recreated from scratch via innerHTML and
  // default back to type="password" every time, regardless of what the
  // user had set before navigating away from this step.
  _armApplyPassVisibility();
}

function renderArmStep() {
  const s = ARM_STEPS[armStep];
  document.getElementById('arm-step-lbl').textContent   = s.label;
  document.getElementById('arm-step-title').textContent  = s.title;
  document.getElementById('arm-step-body').innerHTML     = s.html;
  // Step 3's Admin Ghost / Necessary Struggle tip-icons are injected here,
  // after _tipInit()'s one-time boot pass already ran — without this
  // they'd keep their raw title attribute forever and never get the
  // tap-to-toggle popover/ARIA wiring every other tip-icon on the page has.
  _tipInit();
  document.getElementById('arm-prev').style.display      = armStep > 0 ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('arm-next').innerHTML          = armStep === ARM_STEPS.length - 1
    ? 'Save & Personalize <i class="ti ti-bolt"></i>'
    : 'Continue <i class="ti ti-arrow-right"></i>';
  document.getElementById('arm-err').style.display = 'none';
  _armRestoreStep();
  // Update stepper dots
  for (let i = 1; i <= ARM_STEPS.length; i++) {
    const d = document.getElementById('asdot-' + i);
    if (d) d.className = 'sdot' + (i < armStep + 1 ? ' s-done' : i === armStep + 1 ? ' s-active' : '');
  }
  const firstFocusable = document.querySelector('#arm-step-body input, #arm-step-body select, #arm-step-body textarea, #arm-step-body button');
  if (firstFocusable) firstFocusable.focus();
}

function armNext() {
  const v = ARM_STEPS[armStep].validate();
  if (typeof v === 'string') {
    document.getElementById('arm-err-msg').textContent = v;
    document.getElementById('arm-err').style.display = 'flex';
    return;
  }
  _armCaptureStep();
  if (armStep < ARM_STEPS.length - 1) { armStep++; renderArmStep(); }
  else { submitArmEngine(); }
}

function armPrev() { if (armStep > 0) { _armCaptureStep(); armStep--; renderArmStep(); } }

// Tracked separately from the input's own .type — renderArmStep() rebuilds
// #arm-step-body's innerHTML on every step change (including stepping back
// to step 3 and forward to step 4 again), which recreates the passphrase
// inputs from scratch at their default type="password" regardless of
// whether they'd been revealed before. _armRestoreStep() reapplies this
// after every render so the toggle survives navigating the wizard.
let _armPassVisible = false;
function toggleArmPassVisibility() {
  _armPassVisible = !_armPassVisible;
  _armApplyPassVisibility();
}
function _armApplyPassVisibility() {
  const input   = document.getElementById('arm-passphrase');
  const confirm = document.getElementById('arm-passphrase-confirm');
  const icon    = document.getElementById('arm-pass-toggle-icon');
  const btn     = document.getElementById('arm-pass-toggle');
  if (!input) return;
  const newType = _armPassVisible ? 'text' : 'password';
  input.type = newType;
  // Reveal both fields together — the whole point of the confirm field is
  // catching a mismatch, which is easiest to spot with both shown plainly.
  if (confirm) confirm.type = newType;
  if (icon) icon.className = _armPassVisible ? 'ti ti-eye-off' : 'ti ti-eye';
  if (btn)  btn.setAttribute('aria-label', _armPassVisible ? 'Hide passphrase' : 'Show passphrase');
}

function submitArmEngine() {
  const btn = document.getElementById('arm-next');
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.innerHTML = '<i class="ti ti-loader-2"></i>Saving…';
  // armNext() already called _armCaptureStep() for every step including this
  // one, so armAnswers holds all 4 steps' values — read from there, not the
  // DOM. Reading document.getElementById() here would only ever see step 4's
  // fields (targets/passphrase/email), since steps 1-3's elements were long
  // since replaced by renderArmStep()'s innerHTML swaps.
  const trim = v => (v || '').trim();
  callServer('completeOnboarding', [{
    deployType: armAnswers.armDT || 'INDIVIDUAL',
    role: trim(armAnswers.role), audience: trim(armAnswers.audience), vision: trim(armAnswers.vision),
    adminGhost: trim(armAnswers.adminGhost), struggle: trim(armAnswers.struggle), targets: trim(armAnswers.targets),
    passphrase: armAnswers.passphrase || '',
    adminEmail: trim(armAnswers.adminEmail),
  }], (res) => {
    if (res && res.success) {
      btn.innerHTML = '<i class="ti ti-check"></i>Saved!';
      // Genuine completion — clear the draft instead of persisting it,
      // unlike every other way this modal closes.
      setTimeout(() => { _armResetState(); closeArmModal(true); loadDiagnostics(); }, 1000);
    } else {
      btn.disabled = false;
      btn.innerHTML = 'Save & Personalize <i class="ti ti-bolt"></i>';
      document.getElementById('arm-err-msg').textContent = (res && res.message) || 'Saving failed.';
      document.getElementById('arm-err').style.display = 'flex';
    }
  }, (err) => {
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.innerHTML = 'Save & Personalize <i class="ti ti-bolt"></i>';
    document.getElementById('arm-err-msg').textContent = 'Server error: ' + err.message;
    document.getElementById('arm-err').style.display = 'flex';
  });
}


function loadHealthSummary() {
  callServer('getSystemHealth', [], (res) => {
    const el = document.getElementById('health-summary');
    if (!res || !res.success) {
      _diagPanelError('health-summary', (res && res.message) || 'System state unavailable.', 'loadHealthSummary', 'ti-alert-triangle');
      return;
    }

    const obText = res.onboardingDay > 0
      ? 'Day ' + res.onboardingDay + ' of ' + res.onboardingCap
      : 'Learning from sessions';

    // Engine/admin-email rows below use the app's shared dot/icon-font
    // vocabulary (same as the header's engine-dot and the alert-triangle
    // used everywhere else) instead of ad-hoc emoji (🟢/📡/⚠) — two visual
    // languages for the same "armed/warning" signals in the same tab.
    el.innerHTML =
      '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;font-size:12px;">' +
      healthRowHtml('Engine', res.engineArmed
        ? '<span class="dot dot-armed" style="display:inline-block;margin-right:5px;vertical-align:middle"></span>Personalized'
        : '<span class="dot dot-cold" style="display:inline-block;margin-right:5px;vertical-align:middle"></span>Learning') +
      healthRow('Triggers',    res.triggersActive + ' active') +
      healthRow('Progress',    obText) +
      (res.adminEmail
        ? healthRow('Admin email', res.adminEmail)
        : healthRowHtml('Admin email', '<i class="ti ti-alert-triangle" style="font-size:12px;margin-right:4px"></i>not set')) +
      (res.promotedVectors && res.promotedVectors.length
        ? healthRow('Promoted themes', res.promotedVectors.join(', '))
        : '') +
      '</div>';
  }, (err) => {
    _diagPanelError('health-summary', 'Couldn\'t load — ' + err.message, 'loadHealthSummary', 'ti-alert-triangle');
  });
}

function healthRow(label, val) {
  return healthRowHtml(label, esc(String(val)));
}

// Like healthRow() but takes pre-built HTML for the value instead of escaping
// it — only ever called with hardcoded icon markup (never server-supplied
// text), so this doesn't reopen the escaping that healthRow() still does.
function healthRowHtml(label, html) {
  return '<div style="background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:8px 10px;">' +
    '<div style="font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;color:var(--text3);font-family:var(--mono);margin-bottom:2px;">' + esc(label) + '</div>' +
    '<div style="color:var(--text2);">' + html + '</div>' +
    '</div>';
}

// ── Registrar / Cog Relay status (curriculum-drafts auditing pipeline) ──
// Read-only summary — this pipeline has no Diagnostics action buttons of
// its own (see 11_Registrar_CogRelay.gs's header comment for why:
// clearInterventionTriage(fileId) is still an Apps Script editor action).
// The whole panel stays hidden (see the HTML's display:none defaults)
// until a deployment has actually put something through this ledger —
// most kos-personal installs never touch this second, independent
// pipeline, and an always-visible "0 of everything" panel would just be
// diagnostics-tab noise for them.
function loadRegistrarStatus() {
  callServer('getRegistrarStatus', [], (res) => {
    const lbl  = document.getElementById('registrar-lbl');
    const el   = document.getElementById('registrar-summary');
    const div  = document.getElementById('registrar-divider');
    if (!el) return;

    if (!res || !res.success) {
      // Non-fatal by design: unlike the primary session-log panels above,
      // a Registrar failure shouldn't block the rest of Diagnostics from
      // rendering, and showing an error for a pipeline most deployments
      // never use would be its own kind of noise. Log for anyone who does
      // use it and is debugging via the browser console.
      console.warn('[Diagnostics] getRegistrarStatus failed:', res && res.message);
      return;
    }

    if (!res.total) {
      lbl.style.display = 'none';
      el.style.display = 'none';
      div.style.display = 'none';
      return;
    }

    lbl.style.display = '';
    el.style.display = '';
    div.style.display = '';

    const g = res.groups || {};
    el.innerHTML =
      '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;font-size:12px;">' +
      healthRow('In progress', g.in_progress || 0) +
      (g.needs_review
        ? healthRowHtml('Needs review', '<i class="ti ti-alert-triangle" style="font-size:12px;margin-right:4px;color:var(--danger)"></i>' + g.needs_review + ' held for a teacher')
        : healthRow('Needs review', 0)) +
      healthRow('Routed', g.routed || 0) +
      (g.failed
        ? healthRowHtml('Failed', '<i class="ti ti-alert-triangle" style="font-size:12px;margin-right:4px;color:var(--danger)"></i>' + g.failed)
        : healthRow('Failed', 0)) +
      '</div>';

    // FIXED (Say/Do Ledger kos-personal finding #9): the tooltip used to
    // be static, generic text regardless of whether this pipeline had
    // ever actually finished anything. Made state-aware instead of a
    // caveat someone has to remember to edit out once the Stage 1/2
    // Studio flows are built: once at least one file has ever reached a
    // terminal state (routed OR escalated to CRITICAL_FAILURE — either
    // one proves the pipeline is really moving rows, not just
    // accumulating attempts with nothing built to process them), it
    // stops hedging. Before that point, every "in progress" row is
    // genuinely ambiguous — it could be seconds into a normal audit, or
    // it could be bouncing forever (Attempt_Tracker climbing toward
    // CFG.REGISTRAR_RETRY_LIMIT with no Studio flow ever actually
    // validating it) — so the caveat stays up.
    const tip = document.getElementById('registrar-tip');
    if (tip) {
      const everCompleted = (g.routed || 0) > 0 || (g.failed || 0) > 0;
      tip.title = everCompleted
        ? 'A separate pipeline (11_Registrar_CogRelay.gs) that audits curriculum drafts for structural completeness and pedagogical dissonance — distinct from the session-log pipeline above it on this tab. ' +
          (g.routed || 0) + ' file' + ((g.routed || 0) === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' routed so far.'
        : 'A separate pipeline (11_Registrar_CogRelay.gs) that audits curriculum drafts for structural completeness and pedagogical dissonance. No file has finished routing yet — if its two Studio flows (Stage 1 Auditor, Stage 2 Curator) aren\'t built yet, files here will keep retrying until they exceed the attempt limit and move to Failed for review.';
    }
  }, (err) => {
    console.warn('[Diagnostics] getRegistrarStatus error:', err.message);
  });
}

function loadVectorState() {
  callServer('getVectorState', [], (res) => {
    const el = document.getElementById('vec-list');
    // A genuine failure (res.success === false) used to render identically
    // to "no theme data yet" — same empty-icon treatment, no indication
    // anything was actually wrong, and no way to retry either case.
    if (!res || !res.success) {
      _diagPanelError('vec-list', (res && res.message) || 'Vector state unavailable.', 'loadVectorState', 'ti-alert-triangle');
      return;
    }
    // FIXED (Say/Do Ledger kos-personal finding #4): getVectorState()'s
    // "nothing processed yet" branch still returns a full vectors array
    // (one zero-score entry per known theme, so the list always shows
    // every category name) — checking vectors.length here was dead code,
    // since that array is never actually empty. !res.session_uid is the
    // real "has anything ever written to the matrix" signal (only set
    // once a real session updates it), and is what makes res.message's
    // state-aware text (armed vs. cold-with-sessions-queued vs.
    // cold-with-nothing-queued — see getVectorState()) actually reachable.
    if (!res.vectors || res.vectors.length === 0 || !res.session_uid) {
      el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty" style="padding:8px 0">' +
        '<i class="ti ti-chart-bar" style="font-size:18px;opacity:.4"></i>' +
        (res.message ? esc(res.message) : 'Process your first session to see theme data.') + '</div>';
      // A theme can be incubating toward promotion even before any vector
      // has fully promoted — still worth showing.
      renderIncubating(res);
      return;
    }
    renderVectors(res);
  }, (err) => {
    _diagPanelError('vec-list', 'Couldn\'t load — ' + err.message, 'loadVectorState', 'ti-alert-triangle');
  });
}

function renderVectors(res) {
  const el    = document.getElementById('vec-list');
  const meta  = document.getElementById('vec-meta');
  const vecs  = res.vectors || [];
  const promd = res.promoted_themes || [];

  renderIncubating(res); // independent of whether any theme has promoted yet

  if (vecs.length === 0) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty" style="padding:8px 0">No theme data yet.</div>';
    return;
  }

  el.innerHTML = vecs.map(v => {
    const clamped = Math.min(v.score, 1);
    const pct     = Math.round(clamped * 100);
    const isPromo = promd.includes(v.name);
    const fillCls = isPromo ? 'bar-fill promoted' : 'bar-fill';
    // Bars start at width:0 and grow to their real width just below — set
    // directly to the final width here, the CSS transition has nothing to
    // interpolate from and never visibly plays.
    return '<div class="vec-row">' +
      '<div class="vec-hdr">' +
      '<span class="vec-name">' + esc(v.name) + (isPromo ? ' ✦' : '') + '</span>' +
      '<span class="vec-score">' + clamped.toFixed(2) + '</span>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="bar-bg"><div class="' + fillCls + '" data-w="' + pct + '" style="width:0%"></div></div>' +
      '</div>';
  }).join('');

  requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    el.querySelectorAll('.bar-fill[data-w]').forEach(bar => {
      bar.style.width = bar.getAttribute('data-w') + '%';
    });
  }));

  // Show session provenance so the user knows what these numbers reflect
  if (meta) {
    const uid  = res.session_uid   ? 'Session ' + res.session_uid : '';
    const date = res.last_updated  ? '  ·  ' + _fmtSyncTime(res.last_updated) : '';
    meta.textContent = uid + date || 'Source session unknown';
  }
}

// Themes not yet promoted to a full vector weight, building toward it.
// This data was already fetched by every getVectorState() call and simply
// had no UI at all — a user could trigger "check for promotions" with
// zero visibility into what was actually building toward one.
function renderIncubating(res) {
  const wrap = document.getElementById('incubating-wrap');
  const list = document.getElementById('incubating-list');
  if (!wrap || !list) return;
  const items = (res.incubating || []).filter(v => v.status !== 'DECAYED');
  if (items.length === 0) { wrap.style.display = 'none'; return; }

  const threshold = res.promotion_threshold || 3.0;
  wrap.style.display = '';
  list.innerHTML = items.map(v => {
    const pct = Math.round(Math.min(v.cumulative_score / threshold, 1) * 100);
    // Stable per-theme button id — safe even if the name ever contains
    // anything other than the uppercase-alnum shape _aggregateSentenceVectors_
    // normally produces, since _confirmTap_'s state is keyed by this id.
    const btnId = 'pin-btn-' + v.name.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g, '_');
    return '<div class="vec-row" style="margin-bottom:6px">' +
      '<div class="vec-hdr">' +
      '<span class="vec-name" style="font-size:11px">' + esc(v.name) + '</span>' +
      // FIXED: was toFixed(2) on one side and toFixed(1) on the other for
      // the same score/threshold unit (e.g. "1.85 / 3.0") — matched to the
      // more precise of the two rather than dropping precision.
      '<span class="vec-score" style="font-size:10px">' + v.cumulative_score.toFixed(2) + ' / ' + threshold.toFixed(2) + '</span>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="bar-bg" style="height:4px"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:' + pct + '%;background:var(--text3)"></div></div>' +
      // Manual "pin to Core" override (KOS/CAS roadmap synthesis 2.1) — a
      // theme name lives in data-theme, not inlined into the onclick string,
      // so nothing here needs JS-string escaping on top of esc()'s HTML
      // escaping.
      '<button class="btn btn-sm" id="' + btnId + '" ' +
        'style="margin-top:4px;padding:4px 10px;font-size:11px" ' +
        'data-theme="' + esc(v.name) + '" onclick="handlePinToCore(this)">' +
        '<i class="ti ti-pin"></i>Pin to Core</button>' +
      '</div>';
  }).join('');
}

function loadWebhookUrl() {
  const el = document.getElementById('webhook-url');
  if (webhookUrl) { if (el) el.textContent = webhookUrl; return; }
  callServer('getWebAppUrl', [], (res) => {
    // getWebAppUrl() now reports its own failure via success:false instead
    // of returning a fallback sentence in place of a URL — this branch used
    // to blindly String()-coerce whatever came back, including that
    // sentence, and treat it as a real, copyable webhook URL.
    if (!res || !res.success) {
      if (el) el.textContent = res && res.message ? res.message : 'Couldn\'t load URL — tap to retry';
      return;
    }
    webhookUrl = res.url;
    if (el) el.textContent = webhookUrl;
  }, (err) => {
    // This box is already the tap-to-copy affordance — reused as the retry
    // affordance too instead of adding a separate control (see
    // copyWebhookUrl(), which checks webhookUrl to decide which one applies).
    if (el) el.textContent = 'Couldn\'t load URL — tap to retry';
  });
}

function copyWebhookUrl() {
  if (!webhookUrl) { loadWebhookUrl(); return; }
  const txt = document.getElementById('webhook-url').textContent;
  const showConfirm = (label, ok) => {
    // Confirm right next to the box the user tapped — showDiagStatus()
    // writes into #diag-status at the top of the tab, which isn't visible
    // without scrolling back up from here at the bottom of Diagnostics.
    const el = document.getElementById('webhook-copy-confirm');
    if (!el) return;
    el.textContent = label;
    el.style.color = ok ? 'var(--success)' : 'var(--danger)';
    el.style.display = 'inline';
    setTimeout(() => { el.style.display = 'none'; }, 2200);
  };
  if (navigator.clipboard) {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(() => showConfirm('✓ Copied', true), () => _fallbackCopy(txt, showConfirm));
  } else {
    // navigator.clipboard is missing in some in-app/webview browsers and
    // any non-HTTPS embed — this used to make the whole "tap to copy" box
    // a silent no-op with no error, no confirmation, nothing, despite
    // looking (role="button", keyboard handling) like it should give
    // feedback either way.
    _fallbackCopy(txt, showConfirm);
  }
}

function _fallbackCopy(txt, showConfirm) {
  try {
    const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = txt;
    ta.style.position = 'fixed';
    ta.style.opacity = '0';
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.focus();
    ta.select();
    const ok = document.execCommand('copy');
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
    showConfirm(ok ? '✓ Copied' : 'Couldn\'t copy — select and copy manually', ok);
  } catch (e) {
    showConfirm('Couldn\'t copy — select and copy manually', false);
  }
}


// ── Diagnostics action handlers ────────────────────────────────
function handleSendReport() {
  const btn = document.getElementById('btn-report');
  const gen = beginDiagAction();
  btn.disabled = true;
  showDiagStatus('Sending…', undefined, gen);
  btn.innerHTML = '<i class="ti ti-loader-2"></i>Sending…';
  callServer('sendDailyErrorReport', [], (res) => {
    btn.disabled = false;
    resetBtn('btn-report', 'ti-mail', 'Send error digest now');
    if (res && res.sent) {
      showDiagStatus('Report sent (' + (res.count || 0) + ' error' + ((res.count || 0) === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' to ' + (res.to || 'admin') + ').', undefined, gen);
    } else {
      // error:true marks a genuine exception (5_Error_And_Utilities.gs) —
      // distinct from the benign no-op cases (empty log, nothing new,
      // admin email unset), which used to render identically.
      showDiagStatus((res && res.reason) || 'Nothing new to report.', (res && res.error) ? 'danger' : undefined, gen);
    }
  }, (err) => {
    btn.disabled = false;
    resetBtn('btn-report', 'ti-mail', 'Send error digest now');
    showDiagStatus('Error: ' + err.message, 'danger', gen);
  });
}

function handleArchive() {
  const btn = document.getElementById('btn-archive');
  const gen = beginDiagAction();
  btn.disabled = true;
  showDiagStatus('Archiving…', undefined, gen);
  btn.innerHTML = '<i class="ti ti-loader-2"></i>Archiving…';
  callServer('archiveStagingPipeline', [], (res) => {
    btn.disabled = false;
    resetBtn('btn-archive', 'ti-archive', 'Archive completed queue rows');
    // A genuine exception (res.success === false) used to return the exact
    // same {archived:0,...} shape as a routine "nothing to archive" run,
    // so a real backend failure rendered identically to a benign no-op.
    if (res && res.success === false) {
      showDiagStatus('Error: ' + (res.message || 'Archive failed.'), 'danger', gen);
      return;
    }
    if (res && res.busy) {
      showDiagStatus(res.message, undefined, gen);
      return;
    }
    // archiveStagingPipeline() also sweeps up rows that failed intake and
    // were never shown anywhere else in the Queue UI — this button's label
    // ("Archive completed queue rows") used to imply it only touched
    // finished/successful work, so a failure count is called out
    // explicitly instead of folding silently into one total.
    const archived  = (res && res.archived)  || 0;
    const failed    = (res && res.failed)    || 0;
    const rowWord = archived + ' row' + (archived === 1 ? '' : 's');
    // FIXED: the outer rowWord was pluralized in an earlier round, but this
    // nested clause wasn't — failed === 1 rendered "1 were failed-intake
    // rows, not successes."
    const failedClause = failed === 1
      ? '1 was a failed-intake row, not a success'
      : failed + ' were failed-intake rows, not successes';
    const msg = failed > 0
      ? rowWord + ' archived (' + failedClause + ').'
      : rowWord + ' archived to STAGING_ARCHIVE.';
    showDiagStatus(msg, failed > 0 ? 'warn' : undefined, gen);
  }, (err) => {
    btn.disabled = false;
    resetBtn('btn-archive', 'ti-archive', 'Archive completed queue rows');
    showDiagStatus('Error: ' + err.message, 'danger', gen);
  });
}

function handlePromotion() {
  const btn = document.getElementById('btn-promote');
  const gen = beginDiagAction();
  btn.disabled = true;
  showDiagStatus('Checking incubator…', undefined, gen);
  btn.innerHTML = '<i class="ti ti-loader-2"></i>Checking…';
  callServer('runPromotionCheck', [], (res) => {
    btn.disabled = false;
    resetBtn('btn-promote', 'ti-trending-up', 'Check for new themes to promote');
    // runPromotionCheck() used to return a bare string for both the error
    // and no-op cases, so the web app couldn't tell a real failure from
    // "nothing to promote" and always rendered both in neutral gray.
    const isError = res && res.success === false;
    showDiagStatus((res && res.message) || String(res), isError ? 'danger' : undefined, gen);
    loadVectorState(); // refresh vector display
  }, (err) => {
    btn.disabled = false;
    resetBtn('btn-promote', 'ti-trending-up', 'Check for new themes to promote');
    showDiagStatus('Error: ' + err.message, 'danger', gen);
  });
}

// Companion to handlePromotion() above: that button runs the algorithmic
// threshold check across every incubating theme; this one lets the
// operator declare a single theme permanent outright (KOS/CAS roadmap
// synthesis 2.1 — "pin to Core"), for a one-off but structurally important
// decision that shouldn't have to wait for enough sessions to
// out-accumulate CFG.DECAY_FACTOR. Uses the same double-tap confirm as
// handleCouncil()/handleDeploy() below — this bypasses the normal
// promotion threshold, so it shouldn't fire on a single accidental tap.
function handlePinToCore(btn) {
  const theme = btn.dataset.theme;
  const btnId = btn.id;
  _confirmTap_(btnId, {
    armedClass: 'btn btn-sm btn-confirm btn-countdown',
    armedIcon:  '<i class="ti ti-alert-triangle"></i>',
    armedLabel: (n) => 'Tap again to pin · ' + n + 's',
    onArm: () => showDiagStatus('Tap "Pin to Core" again within 5 seconds to confirm — this bypasses the normal promotion threshold.', undefined, beginDiagAction()),
    onExpire: () => {
      resetBtn(btnId, 'ti-pin', 'Pin to Core');
      showDiagStatus('', undefined, beginDiagAction());
    },
    onConfirm: () => {
      const gen = beginDiagAction();
      btn.disabled = true;
      btn.className = 'btn btn-sm';
      btn.innerHTML = '<i class="ti ti-loader-2"></i>Pinning…';
      showDiagStatus('Pinning "' + theme + '" to Core…', undefined, gen);
      callServer('pinThemeToCore', [theme], (res) => {
        btn.disabled = false;
        const isError = res && res.success === false;
        showDiagStatus((res && res.message) || String(res), isError ? 'danger' : undefined, gen);
        loadVectorState(); // refresh — a successful pin moves the theme out of this list
      }, (err) => {
        btn.disabled = false;
        resetBtn(btnId, 'ti-pin', 'Pin to Core');
        showDiagStatus('Error: ' + err.message, 'danger', gen);
      });
    }
  });
}

// ── Shared confirm-tap helper (Say/Do Ledger kos-personal finding #7)
// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// handleCouncil() and handleDeploy() used to each hand-roll their own
// armed/timer/count state and 5s countdown loop — identical shape, only
// the copy and the confirmed action differed. Consolidated into one
// helper so the WCAG 2.2.1 (Timing Adjustable) fix below only has to be
// written once: a bare auto-revert with no way to ask for more time
// fails that criterion. Pausing the countdown while the button has
// hover or keyboard focus is a genuine "need more time" affordance that
// needs no extra UI of its own — anyone reading the countdown just
// keeps their pointer/focus on it; the clock only resumes once they
// actually look away. A second tap while armed still confirms
// immediately (that's the whole point of the pattern), so hover/focus
// pausing doesn't conflict with the confirm gesture.
const _confirmTapState = {}; // keyed by btnId

function _confirmTap_(btnId, opts) {
  // opts: { armedClass, armedIcon, armedLabel(count), onArm(), onExpire(), onConfirm() }
  const btn = document.getElementById(btnId);
  if (!btn) return;
  let st = _confirmTapState[btnId];

  if (!st || !st.armed) {
    st = _confirmTapState[btnId] = { armed: true, timer: null, count: 5, hovering: false, focused: false };
    btn.className = opts.armedClass;
    btn.innerHTML = opts.armedIcon + opts.armedLabel(st.count);

    if (!btn._confirmTapWired) {
      btn._confirmTapWired = true;
      const cur = () => _confirmTapState[btnId];
      btn.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => { const x = cur(); if (x) x.hovering = true; });
      btn.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { const x = cur(); if (x) x.hovering = false; });
      btn.addEventListener('focus',      () => { const x = cur(); if (x) x.focused  = true; });
      btn.addEventListener('blur',       () => { const x = cur(); if (x) x.focused  = false; });
    }

    if (opts.onArm) opts.onArm();

    st.timer = setInterval(() => {
      const s = _confirmTapState[btnId];
      if (!s || !s.armed) return;
      if (s.hovering || s.focused) return; // paused — genuine "more time"
      s.count--;
      if (s.count <= 0) {
        clearInterval(s.timer);
        s.armed = false;
        opts.onExpire();
      } else {
        btn.innerHTML = opts.armedIcon + opts.armedLabel(s.count);
      }
    }, 1000);
    return;
  }

  clearInterval(st.timer);
  st.armed = false;
  opts.onConfirm();
}

function handleCouncil() {
  _confirmTap_('btn-council', {
    armedClass: 'btn btn-sm btn-confirm btn-countdown',
    armedIcon:  '<i class="ti ti-alert-triangle"></i>',
    armedLabel: (n) => 'Tap again to confirm · ' + n + 's',
    // FIXED: this used to pass no token and skip beginDiagAction() entirely,
    // bypassing the generation-token race guard every other showDiagStatus()
    // call site respects — a stray Diagnostics response landing during the
    // 5s countdown could silently clobber (or be clobbered by) this line.
    onArm: () => showDiagStatus('Tap "Run full council review" again within 5 seconds to confirm.', undefined, beginDiagAction()),
    onExpire: () => {
      resetBtn('btn-council', 'ti-brain', 'Run full council review');
      // FIXED: the aria-live line above kept asserting "tap again within
      // 5 seconds" indefinitely after the window actually closed — a
      // screen-reader user (or anyone reading the status line late) had
      // no way to tell the countdown had lapsed and the button reverted.
      showDiagStatus('', undefined, beginDiagAction());
    },
    onConfirm: () => {
      const btn = document.getElementById('btn-council');
      btn.disabled = true;
      btn.className = 'btn btn-sm';
      btn.innerHTML = '<i class="ti ti-loader-2"></i>Queuing…';
      const gen = beginDiagAction();
      // FIXED (Say/Do Ledger kos-personal finding #1): this used to call
      // triggerCouncilSimulation(), which asks one Studio flow to role-play
      // ARCHITECT/AUDITOR/MUSE together in a single shared-context pass —
      // exactly the cross-contamination BRIDGE_FIDELITY_001 forbids. The
      // real Seven Bridges execution layer (SMP-002) is now built —
      // triggerSevenBridgesReview() generates one stimulus doc and a fresh
      // council ID; the operator sends that doc to each cog independently
      // and logs each verdict via Ingest → Cog Verdict under that ID.
      showDiagStatus('Preparing a Seven Bridges review stimulus…', undefined, gen);
      callServer('triggerSevenBridgesReview', [], (res) => {
        btn.disabled = false;
        resetBtn('btn-council', 'ti-brain', 'Run full council review');
        if (res && res.success && (res.busy || res.noop)) {
          // Lock contention or "nothing changed since last run" — both routine,
          // expected outcomes, not failures. Render neutrally instead of red.
          showDiagStatus(res.message, undefined, gen);
        } else if (res && res.success) {
          showDiagStatusHtml(
            'Stimulus ready — Council ID <strong>' + esc(res.councilId) + '</strong>. ' +
            'Send it to each cog independently (separate Gemini conversation per cog, ' +
            'no shared context), then log each verdict under this Council ID via ' +
            '<strong>Ingest → Cog Verdict</strong>.',
            undefined, gen
          );
        } else {
          showDiagStatus((res && res.message) || 'Could not start council.', 'danger', gen);
        }
      }, (err) => {
        btn.disabled = false;
        resetBtn('btn-council', 'ti-brain', 'Run full council review');
        // _coldEngineGate's TIER_2 throw leaks its internal function name, tier
        // label, and "Socratic Onboarding" (a term this UI doesn't otherwise
        // use — the button here says "Personalize your advisor"). Translate
        // that one specific case; anything else still shows Server error as-is.
        const msg = /COLD_ENGINE_TIER_2/.test(err.message)
          ? 'Your advisor isn\'t personalized yet — tap "Personalize your advisor" in Diagnostics first.'
          : 'Error: ' + err.message;
        showDiagStatus(msg, 'danger', gen);
      });
    }
  });
}

function toggleDeployDetail() {
  const d = document.getElementById('deploy-detail');
  const b = document.querySelector('.detail-toggle');
  const showing = d.classList.toggle('show');
  if (b) b.textContent = showing ? 'Hide technical detail' : 'Show technical detail';
}

function resetBtn(id, icon, label) {
  const btn = document.getElementById(id);
  btn.className = 'btn btn-sm';
  btn.innerHTML = '<i class="ti ' + icon + '"></i>' + label;
}

// All 7 Diagnostics action buttons write into this one shared status line
// with no ordering guarantee otherwise — if a slower call's response lands
// after a faster, more recently-started action's response, it would
// silently overwrite the newer (and more relevant) message. beginDiagAction()
// hands each action handler a token; showDiagStatus() only applies a call
// if its token still matches the most recently started action (or the
// caller didn't pass one, e.g. the generic onServerError() fallback).
let _diagActionGen = 0;
function beginDiagAction() { return ++_diagActionGen; }

// Plain text by default: several messages carry server text (error
// messages, theme names that came out of the classifier's model output),
// which must never be parsed as HTML. showDiagStatusHtml() is for the one
// message that needs markup, with every value in it escaped.
function showDiagStatus(text, type, token) {
  showDiagStatusHtml(esc(text), type, token);
}

function showDiagStatusHtml(html, type, token) {
  if (token !== undefined && token !== _diagActionGen) return; // superseded by a newer action
  const el = document.getElementById('diag-status');
  el.innerHTML = html;
  if (type === 'danger') el.style.color = 'var(--danger)';
  else if (type === 'warn') el.style.color = 'var(--amber)';
  else el.style.color = 'var(--text3)';
}


// ── Utilities ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Internal state/enum names → plain-language labels. Never print an
// engine_mode/status enum straight into the DOM — a user reads "COLD" or
// "HYPOTHESIZED" as backend jargon, not a status they can act on.
const ENGINE_MODE_LABELS = { CALIBRATED: 'Personalized', LEARNING: 'Learning you', COLD: 'Not started' };
const SHADOW_STATUS_LABELS = { VERIFIED: 'Confirmed', HYPOTHESIZED: 'Best guess', UNKNOWN: 'Not started' };
function friendlyEngineMode(mode) { return ENGINE_MODE_LABELS[mode] || mode || 'v8.0'; }
function friendlyShadowStatus(status) { return SHADOW_STATUS_LABELS[status] || status; }

function esc(str) {
  return String(str)
    .replace(/&/g,'&amp;')
    .replace(/</g,'&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g,'&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g,'&quot;');
}


// ── Bootstrap screen handlers ───────────────────────────────────

const BS_STEPS = [
  'Setting up your private workspace',
  'Organizing your Drive folders',
  'Creating your AI advisor team',
  'Installing background automation',
  'Finishing up',
];
let bsStepTimer = null;

function handleBootstrap() {
  // Transition: idle → active
  document.getElementById('bs-idle').style.display   = 'none';
  document.getElementById('bs-active').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('bs-err').style.display    = 'none';

  // Animate progress steps while deploy runs server-side
  let current = 0;
  const steps = document.querySelectorAll('.prog-step');
  // FIXED: a retry ("Try again" after a failed attempt) never cleared the
  // active/done/err classes or icon left over from the previous run —
  // advanceStep() below only ever adds active/done, it never removes err.
  // A step that failed on attempt 1 and then succeeded on retry could end
  // up with both .done (✅ icon) and the stale .err class still attached;
  // since .err is declared after .active/.done in the stylesheet, it won
  // the cascade and rendered the label in error-red despite the checkmark.
  steps.forEach(s => {
    s.classList.remove('active', 'done', 'err');
    const icon = s.querySelector('.p-icon');
    if (icon) icon.textContent = '⬜';
  });

  const advanceStep = () => {
    if (current < steps.length) {
      if (current > 0) {
        steps[current - 1].querySelector('.p-icon').textContent = '✅';
        steps[current - 1].classList.remove('active');
        steps[current - 1].classList.add('done');
      }
      steps[current].querySelector('.p-icon').textContent = '⏳';
      steps[current].classList.add('active');
      current++;
    }
  };

  advanceStep(); // Start first step immediately
  // Space remaining steps across ~50 seconds (typical deploy time)
  const stepDelay = 10000;
  bsStepTimer = setInterval(() => {
    if (current < steps.length) advanceStep();
    else clearInterval(bsStepTimer);
  }, stepDelay);

  callServer('executeBootstrap', [], (res) => {
    clearInterval(bsStepTimer);

    if (res && res.success) {
      // Complete remaining steps in a quick stagger rather than all at once —
      // real deploys regularly finish well inside the ~50s animation
      // estimate, and snapping 3+ steps to done() simultaneously looked
      // like they'd been skipped rather than actually finished.
      const remaining = Array.from(steps).filter(s => !s.classList.contains('done'));
      remaining.forEach((s, i) => {
        setTimeout(() => {
          s.querySelector('.p-icon').textContent = '✅';
          s.classList.remove('active'); s.classList.add('done');
        }, i * 220);
      });
      const staggerMs = remaining.length * 220;
      // Append tech detail (collapsed by default)
      const detail = document.getElementById('deploy-detail');
      if (detail && res.log && res.log.length) {
        detail.innerHTML = res.log.map(l =>
          '<div class="' + (l.startsWith('✔') || l.startsWith('✅') ? 'l-ok' : l.startsWith('⚠') ? 'l-warn' : '') + '">' + esc(l) + '</div>'
        ).join('');
        const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('detail-toggle-btn');
        if (toggleBtn) toggleBtn.style.display = '';
      }
      // Transition: active → done (after the stagger above finishes)
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.getElementById('bs-active').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('bs-done').style.display   = 'block';
      }, 600 + staggerMs);
      // Reload after user has a moment to read the success message
      setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 3500 + staggerMs);

    } else {
      clearInterval(bsStepTimer);
      // Mark current step as error
      steps.forEach((s, i) => {
        if (s.classList.contains('active')) {
          s.querySelector('.p-icon').textContent = '❌';
          s.classList.remove('active'); s.classList.add('err');
        }
      });
      const errEl  = document.getElementById('bs-err');
      const msgEl  = document.getElementById('bs-err-msg');
      if (msgEl) msgEl.textContent = (res && res.message) || 'Something went wrong.';
      if (errEl) errEl.style.display = 'flex';

      // deployFullSystem() has no top-level `message` field — the real
      // per-step detail lives in res.errors[]/res.log[], which the success
      // path already surfaces via this same element. Show it here too,
      // instead of leaving the user with only the generic fallback above.
      const detail = document.getElementById('deploy-detail');
      if (detail && ((res && res.errors && res.errors.length) || (res && res.log && res.log.length))) {
        const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('detail-toggle-btn');
        if (toggleBtn) toggleBtn.style.display = '';
        const lines = [].concat(res.log || [], res.errors || []);
        detail.innerHTML = lines.map(l =>
          '<div class="' + (String(l).startsWith('✔') || String(l).startsWith('✅') ? 'l-ok' : String(l).startsWith('⚠') || String(l).startsWith('❌') ? 'l-err' : '') + '">' + esc(l) + '</div>'
        ).join('');
      }

      // Show retry option
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.getElementById('bs-active').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('bs-idle').style.display   = 'block';
        document.getElementById('btn-bootstrap').innerHTML = '<i class="ti ti-refresh"></i>Try again';
      }, 1000);
    }
  }, (serverErr) => {
    clearInterval(bsStepTimer);
    const errEl = document.getElementById('bs-err');
    const msgEl = document.getElementById('bs-err-msg');
    if (msgEl) msgEl.textContent = 'Server error: ' + serverErr.message;
    if (errEl) errEl.style.display = 'flex';
    setTimeout(() => {
      document.getElementById('bs-active').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('bs-idle').style.display   = 'block';
      document.getElementById('btn-bootstrap').innerHTML = '<i class="ti ti-refresh"></i>Try again';
    }, 800);
  });
}


// ── selectDeploy (shared by arm modal radio buttons) ────────────
function selectDeploy(el) {
  // Target only the radio group containing this element
  const group = el.closest('.radio-group');
  if (group) group.querySelectorAll('.radio-item').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('selected'));
  el.classList.add('selected');
}


// ── Mobile-friendly tooltips ────────────────────────────────────────────
// .tip-icon instances only ever exposed their help text via the native
// `title` attribute — hover-only, so unreachable on any touch device, and
// not real ARIA wiring for screen readers either. Converts each one to a
// tap/click-to-toggle popover, keyboard-operable, with one shared popover
// element reused across all icons.
let _tipOpenIcon = null;
// Idempotent by design (only ever matches elements still carrying a raw
// `title`, which get it stripped as their very first step below) — safe
// to call again any time new .tip-icon markup is injected into the page
// after the initial boot pass, e.g. Arm modal step HTML swapped in by
// renderArmStep() (see call below). The two document-level listeners are
// registered once, outside this function, so calling it repeatedly never
// piles up duplicate click/Escape handlers.
function _tipInit() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tip-icon[title]').forEach(el => {
    el.dataset.tip = el.getAttribute('title');
    el.removeAttribute('title');
    el.setAttribute('role', 'button');
    el.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
    el.setAttribute('aria-haspopup', 'true');
    el.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    el.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); toggleTip(el); });
    el.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); toggleTip(el); }
    });
  });
}
document.addEventListener('click', () => closeTip());
// FIXED: this used to be `if (e.key === 'Escape') closeTip();` with no
// stopImmediatePropagation — since this listener is registered at script
// load (before any modal-specific Escape handler, e.g. _armEscHandler,
// which is only added once a modal opens), it always ran first but never
// stopped the same keypress from also reaching those later handlers. On
// the Arm wizard's Step 3, dismissing a tip popover with Escape therefore
// also closed the whole modal in the same keystroke. closeArmModal() no
// longer force-clears armStep/armAnswers on any dismissal path (see
// persistArmDraft()/restoreArmDraft() above), but Escape should still be
// "spent" on the topmost open thing rather than also dismissing a wizard
// the user didn't ask to close — stop it here only when there was
// actually a tip to close.
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.key !== 'Escape' || !_tipOpenIcon) return;
  closeTip();
  e.stopImmediatePropagation();
});
// toggleTip() computes the popover's position once, at open time, from
// the icon's getBoundingClientRect() — with no scroll/resize handling,
// scrolling .content (the tab body's own internal scroll container) after
// opening a tip left the popover pinned to its original screen position
// while the icon it was anchored to scrolled away underneath it. Simplest
// correct fix is to close on either event rather than try to keep a
// fixed-position popover glued to a moving target.
document.addEventListener('scroll', () => closeTip(), true);
window.addEventListener('resize', () => closeTip());
function toggleTip(el) {
  if (_tipOpenIcon === el) { closeTip(); return; }
  closeTip();
  let pop = document.getElementById('shared-tip-popover');
  if (!pop) {
    pop = document.createElement('div');
    pop.id = 'shared-tip-popover';
    pop.className = 'tip-popover';
    pop.setAttribute('role', 'tooltip');
    pop.hidden = true;
    document.body.appendChild(pop);
  }
  pop.textContent = el.dataset.tip || '';
  el.setAttribute('aria-describedby', pop.id);
  el.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
  pop.hidden = false;
  const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
  const maxW = 260;
  let left = r.left;
  if (left + maxW > window.innerWidth - 12) left = Math.max(12, window.innerWidth - maxW - 12);
  pop.style.left = left + 'px';
  pop.style.top  = (r.bottom + 6) + 'px';
  _tipOpenIcon = el;
}
function closeTip() {
  if (!_tipOpenIcon) return;
  const pop = document.getElementById('shared-tip-popover');
  if (pop) pop.hidden = true;
  _tipOpenIcon.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  _tipOpenIcon.removeAttribute('aria-describedby');
  _tipOpenIcon = null;
}

// ── Boot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
(function init() {
  _tipInit();
  // Finding #6 — arrow/Home/End key navigation for both tab groups.
  _wireTabGroup_(NAV_TABS, switchTab);
  _wireTabGroup_(TYPE_TABS, switchType);
  if (SERVER_MODE === 'BOOTSTRAP') {
    document.getElementById('screen-bootstrap').classList.add('show');

  } else {
    // OPERATIONAL — reveal the main app immediately.
    // No ONBOARDING gate: ambient shadow matrix calibrates passively.
    document.getElementById('op-header').style.display = '';
    document.getElementById('main-content').style.display = '';
    document.getElementById('op-nav').style.display = '';
    restoreIngestDraft();

    // Shadow matrix ping — sets header engine mode dot on load.
    // Both calls here pass their own onErr (-> console only) instead of
    // falling through to the untokened onServerError(), which writes
    // unconditionally to #diag-status — these two boot-time pings aren't
    // user-initiated Diagnostics actions and have no business overwriting
    // a fresher, in-flight one (see beginDiagAction()/showDiagStatus()'s
    // token mechanism above).
    if (gsr) {
      callServer('getShadowMatrixStatus', [], (res) => {
        if (!res || !res.success) return;
        const modeColors = { CALIBRATED:'dot-armed', LEARNING:'dot-cold', COLD:'dot-unk' };
        const dot = document.getElementById('engine-dot');
        const lbl = document.getElementById('engine-label');
        if (dot) dot.className = 'dot ' + (modeColors[res.engine_mode] || 'dot-unk');
        if (lbl) lbl.textContent = friendlyEngineMode(res.engine_mode);
      }, (err) => {
        console.warn('[Boot] getShadowMatrixStatus failed:', err);
      });

      // Pre-fetch inbound folder URL for the large-payload drop panel
      callServer('getInboundFolderUrl', [], (res) => {
        if (res && res.url) {
          inboundFolderUrl = res.url;
          const link = document.getElementById('inbound-folder-link');
          if (link) link.href = res.url;
        }
      }, (err) => {
        console.warn('[Boot] getInboundFolderUrl failed:', err);
      });
    }
  }
})();

</script>
</body>
</html>

function _getUi() {

  try { return DocumentApp.getUi(); }   catch (_) {}

  const mock = {

    ButtonSet: { OK: 'OK', YES_NO: 'YES_NO', OK_CANCEL: 'OK_CANCEL' },
  };
  return mock;
}

/**
 * 8-step guided onboarding that arms the KOS engine.
 * Collects operator philosophy, seals it in CORE_THESIS,
 * generates the Identity Key, and sets THESIS_VERIFIED = true.
 *
 * Safe to re-run — prompts to confirm restart if already armed.
 * In v8.0, the web app Diagnostics tab will eventually host a
 * form-based version. This HITL version remains for editor use.
 */
function runSocraticOnboarding() {
  const ui    = _getUi();
  const props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  if (props.getProperty(CFG.PROP.THESIS_VERIFIED) === 'true') {
    const restart = ui.alert('Engine Already Armed',
      'Engine is armed. Day ' + (props.getProperty(CFG.PROP.ONBOARDING_DAY) || 1) +
      ' of ' + CFG.ONBOARDING_DAYS + '.\n\nRestart and reset your thesis?',
      ui.ButtonSet.YES_NO);
    if (restart !== ui.Button.YES) return;
    // FIXED (Say/Do Ledger kos-personal finding #10): this used to only
    // clear the "armed" markers, leaving every per-question answer
    // (role, audience, targets, etc.) sitting in Script Properties from
    // before — a genuine restart now clears those too, so it's an actual
    // clean slate instead of silently pre-filling stale answers via the
    // resume logic below.
    [
      'IDENTITY_KEY', 'IDENTITY_KEY_SALT',
      CFG.PROP.THESIS_VERIFIED, CFG.PROP.ONBOARDING_DAY, CFG.PROP.ONBOARDING_START,
      CFG.PROP.OPERATOR_ROLE, CFG.PROP.OPERATOR_AUDIENCE, CFG.PROP.ADMIN_GHOST,
      CFG.PROP.NECESSARY_STRUGGLE, CFG.PROP.RELATIONAL_TARGETS, CFG.PROP.VISION_90_DAY,
      CFG.PROP.DEPLOYMENT_TYPE,
    ].forEach(k => props.deleteProperty(k));
  }

  // FIXED (finding #10): the doc comment and the welcome alert both
  // promised "cancel at any time and resume later," but `a` used to be a
  // fresh, empty object every call, and every props.setProperty() write
  // happened only after all 8 questions completed — cancelling partway
  // silently discarded every prior answer. Each answer below is now
  // persisted to Script Properties the moment it's given (PERSIST_MAP),
  // and a resumed run reads back whatever's already there instead of
  // re-asking for it — "resume" and the running recap below are both
  // real now, not aspirational copy.
  const PERSIST_MAP = {
    role:       CFG.PROP.OPERATOR_ROLE,
    audience:   CFG.PROP.OPERATOR_AUDIENCE,
    adminGhost: CFG.PROP.ADMIN_GHOST,
    struggle:   CFG.PROP.NECESSARY_STRUGGLE,
    targets:    CFG.PROP.RELATIONAL_TARGETS,
    vision:     CFG.PROP.VISION_90_DAY,
  };
  const RECAP_LABELS = {
    role: 'Role', audience: 'Audience', adminGhost: 'Admin Ghost',
    struggle: 'Necessary Struggle', targets: 'Relational Targets', vision: '90-Day Vision',
  };

  const a = {};
  Object.keys(PERSIST_MAP).forEach(key => { a[key] = props.getProperty(PERSIST_MAP[key]) || null; });
  a.salt       = props.getProperty('IDENTITY_KEY_SALT')        || null;
  a.deployType = props.getProperty(CFG.PROP.DEPLOYMENT_TYPE)   || null;
  const resuming = Object.keys(PERSIST_MAP).some(k => a[k]);

  ui.alert(
    resuming ? '🧠 Resuming KOS Socratic Onboarding' : '🧠 Welcome to KOS Socratic Onboarding',
    (resuming
      ? 'Picking up where you left off — already-answered questions won\'t be asked again.\n\n'
      : '8 questions. ~10 minutes.\n\n') +
    'The system ships with no philosophy pre-installed.\n' +
    'What you define here is yours alone — it cannot be replicated without your\n' +
    'answers and passphrase.\n\nYou can cancel at any time and resume later.',
    ui.ButtonSet.OK);

  // A short running summary of what's already answered, prepended into
  // each remaining question's prompt — real now that answers persist
  // immediately instead of only existing in memory for one uninterrupted
  // run.
  const recap = () => {
    const answered = Object.keys(PERSIST_MAP).filter(k => a[k]);
    if (!answered.length) return '';
    return 'So far — ' + answered.map(k => RECAP_LABELS[k] + ': ' + a[k]).join(' · ') + '\n\n';
  };

  const ask = (step, field, title, body) => {
    if (PERSIST_MAP[field] && a[field]) return a[field]; // already answered on a prior run — skip
    const r = ui.prompt('Step ' + step + ' of ' + CFG.TOTAL_ONBOARDING_STEPS + ' — ' + title, recap() + body, ui.ButtonSet.OK_CANCEL);
    if (r.getSelectedButton() !== ui.Button.OK) return null;
    const val = r.getResponseText().trim() || null;
    if (val && PERSIST_MAP[field]) {
      props.setProperty(PERSIST_MAP[field], val);
      a[field] = val;
    }
    return val;
  };

  a.role = ask(1, 'role', 'WHAT IS YOUR ROLE?',
    'Your primary role or domain.\nExamples: Marketing Teacher, Business Coach, Software Developer');
  // FIXED (finding #5): menu path updated to match onOpen()'s rename above.
  if (!a.role) return ui.alert('Paused', 'Resume anytime with 🧠 Admin → Personalize Your Advisor.', ui.ButtonSet.OK);

  a.audience = ask(2, 'audience', 'WHO DO YOU SERVE?',
    'The people whose growth your work directly affects.\nExamples: High school students, Small business owners');
  if (!a.audience) return ui.alert('Paused', 'Resume anytime.', ui.ButtonSet.OK);

  a.adminGhost = ask(3, 'adminGhost', 'NAME YOUR ADMIN GHOST',
    'What does administrative drag steal from you specifically, and how many hours per week?\nExamples: Grading formatting 4hr/wk. Parent email management 3hr/wk.');
  if (!a.adminGhost) return ui.alert('Paused', 'Resume anytime.', ui.ButtonSet.OK);

  a.struggle = ask(4, 'struggle', 'THE NECESSARY STRUGGLE',
    'What cognitive friction do you REFUSE to automate?\nExamples: Students must write their own business plan.');
  if (!a.struggle) return ui.alert('Paused', 'Resume anytime.', ui.ButtonSet.OK);

  a.targets = ask(5, 'targets', 'RELATIONAL TARGETS',
    'Your top 3–5 Carbon-to-Carbon relationships (comma separated).\nThese are the people this system exists to protect time for.');
  if (!a.targets) return ui.alert('Paused', 'Resume anytime.', ui.ButtonSet.OK);

  a.vision = ask(6, 'vision', '90-DAY VISION',
    'In one sentence: what does success look like in 90 days if KOS is working perfectly?\nBe specific. Vague visions produce vague results.');
  if (!a.vision) return ui.alert('Paused', 'Resume anytime.', ui.ButtonSet.OK);

  if (!a.salt) {
    // FIXED (finding #10): added a confirmation field — no platform
    // limitation prevents this (unlike ui.prompt()'s missing default-
    // value parameter, worked around in updateRelationalTargets() above),
    // and "YOU WILL NOT BE ASKED AGAIN" makes a typo here unusually
    // costly. Retries in place up to 3 times on a mismatch — same
    // Contextual Gates retry convention used elsewhere in this repo —
    // rather than silently sealing a passphrase the operator may have
    // mistyped.
    let confirmedSalt = null;
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3 && !confirmedSalt; attempt++) {
      const first = ask(7, 'salt', 'IDENTITY KEY PASSPHRASE' + (attempt > 0 ? ' — Retry' : ''),
        '⚠ CRITICAL — READ CAREFULLY\n\nCreate a private passphrase (anything memorable).\n' +
        'This combines with your thesis to generate a unique Identity Key.\n\n' +
        'YOU WILL NOT BE ASKED AGAIN. Write it down first.');
      if (!first) return ui.alert('Paused', 'Resume anytime.', ui.ButtonSet.OK);

      const confirmResp = ui.prompt('Step 7 of ' + CFG.TOTAL_ONBOARDING_STEPS + ' — CONFIRM PASSPHRASE',
        'Type your passphrase again to confirm it.', ui.ButtonSet.OK_CANCEL);
      if (confirmResp.getSelectedButton() !== ui.Button.OK) return ui.alert('Paused', 'Resume anytime.', ui.ButtonSet.OK);
      const second = confirmResp.getResponseText().trim();

      if (first === second) {
        confirmedSalt = first;
      } else if (attempt === 2) {
        ui.alert('⚠ Passphrase Mismatch — Setup Paused',
          'The two entries didn\'t match after 3 attempts.\n\n' +
          'Resume anytime with 🧠 Admin → Personalize Your Advisor to try again.',
          ui.ButtonSet.OK);
        return;
      } else {
        ui.alert('⚠ Passphrase Mismatch — Try Again', 'The two entries didn\'t match.', ui.ButtonSet.OK);
      }
    }
    a.salt = confirmedSalt;
  }
  props.setProperty('IDENTITY_KEY_SALT', a.salt);

  a.deployType = ask(8, 'deployType', 'DEPLOYMENT TYPE',
    'License: Polyform Noncommercial 1.0.0 — free for noncommercial use.\n' +
    'Commercial use: honor system with attribution.\n\n' +
    'Type one of: INDIVIDUAL, EDUCATOR, COMMERCIAL');
  if (!a.deployType) return ui.alert('Paused', 'Resume anytime.', ui.ButtonSet.OK);

  const dt = ['INDIVIDUAL','EDUCATOR','COMMERCIAL'].includes((a.deployType||'').toUpperCase())
    ? a.deployType.toUpperCase() : 'INDIVIDUAL';

  // role/audience/adminGhost/struggle/targets/vision are already
  // persisted incrementally above (see PERSIST_MAP inside ask()) —
  // only the normalized deployType still needs writing here, since its
  // raw (possibly-lowercase) text form isn't what should end up stored.
  props.setProperty(CFG.PROP.DEPLOYMENT_TYPE, dt);

  Object.entries(_inferCalibrationWeights(a.role)).forEach(([k, v]) => {
    if (!props.getProperty(k)) props.setProperty(k, String(v));
  });

  _seedCoreThesisDoc(a, dt);
  generateIdentityKey();
  props.setProperty(CFG.PROP.THESIS_VERIFIED, 'true');
  props.setProperty(CFG.PROP.ONBOARDING_DAY,  '1');
  props.setProperty(CFG.PROP.ONBOARDING_START, new Date().toISOString());
  _logOnboardingDay(1, 'SEALED', a.vision);

  ui.alert('✅ Engine Armed — Onboarding Complete',
    'Deployment: ' + dt + '\n' +
    'Relational Targets: ' + a.targets + '\n\n' +
    'Your 90-Day Vision:\n"' + a.vision + '"\n\n' +
    'NEXT STEPS:\n' +
    '1. Open the KOS web app → Ingest tab\n' +
    '2. Paste your first session log → Queue Payload\n' +
    // FIXED (finding #5): "FLOW_COMPLETE" is the raw pipeline status name
    // — the web app's own Queue tab never shows it to a user either
    // (getQueueMetrics() folds it into the plain "Processing" tile).
    // Described here the same way instead of surfacing the internal term.
    '3. Let Studio process it → check the Queue tab to see it marked complete\n\n' +
    'Day 1 of ' + CFG.ONBOARDING_DAYS + '. The system is live.',
    ui.ButtonSet.OK);
}


// ================================================================
// SESSION CONTEXT BUILDER — HITL (v8.0 Adapted)
// ================================================================

/**
 * Assembles a session context injection block from CORE_THESIS,
 * PIVOTS_AND_LESSONS, the latest VECTOR_MATRIX row, and Relational
 * Targets. Writes the result to a new Google Doc in Drive and
 * shows the URL.
 *
 * v8.0 ADAPTATION: The original wrote to DocumentApp.getActiveDocument()
 * (Drop Zone). In standalone mode there is no active document.
 * This version creates a new doc and surfaces the URL.
 */
function buildSessionContext() {
  const ui    = _getUi();
  const props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  try {
    _coldEngineGate('buildSessionContext', 'TIER_2');
    const sections = [], loaded = [];

    const readDoc = (id, label, maxChars) => {
      if (!id) return;
      try {
        const text = DocumentApp.openById(id).getBody().getText();
        if (text.length > 50) {
          // Refactored onto the shared helper (5_Error_And_Utilities.gs) —
          // this was already correct (marker included), just duplicated
          // inline instead of sharing the one implementation every other
          // truncation call site now also uses (Addendum 22 R2).
          sections.push('## ' + label + '\n' + _truncateWithMarker_(text, maxChars));
          loaded.push(label);
        }
      } catch (_) { console.warn('[buildSessionContext] Could not load ' + label); }
    };

    readDoc(props.getProperty('ID_CORE_THESIS'),       'CORE_THESIS',        1500);
    readDoc(props.getProperty('ID_PIVOTS_AND_LESSONS'),'PIVOTS_AND_LESSONS', 2000);

    const manFiles = DriveApp.getFilesByName('RTP_USER_MANUAL_v1.0');
    if (manFiles.hasNext()) readDoc(manFiles.next().getId(), 'RTP_USER_MANUAL', 1200);

    try {
      const ss     = _getSystemAsset(CFG.INDEX_NAME, 'INDEX_ID', false);
      const matrix = _getOrCreateSheet(ss, CFG.VECTOR_MATRIX_SHEET);
      if (matrix.getLastRow() > 1) {
        // The decayed state over every session, not the last row: each
        // row holds one session's own scores (_writeMatrixRow).
        const state = _vmDecayedState_(ss, matrix);
        let primer = '## VECTOR_MATRIX — STARTUP CALIBRATION\n';
        state.themes.forEach(t => {
          primer += '  ' + String(t).padEnd(22) + state.scores[t] + '\n';
        });
        sections.push(primer);
        loaded.push('BRAIN_TRUST_INDEX (Vector Primer)');
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    const targets = getRelationalTargets();
    if (targets.length > 0) {
      sections.push('## RELATIONAL TARGETS (Protect These Relationships)\n' +
        targets.map((t, i) => (i + 1) + '. ' + t).join('\n'));
    }

    // Roadmap 2.3 — value-consistency drift. The ALIGNMENT persona
    // (PERSONA_ALIGNMENT_V5_1.md §2.2 Threshold D) has no feed of
    // Core-pinned facts otherwise: it only ever sees this chat's own
    // context window, never live sheet state. This is that feed — the
    // same session-start injection point Frequency Drift's own inputs
    // (VECTOR_MATRIX, RELATIONAL TARGETS) already use above, not a new
    // mechanism.
    try {
      const coreFacts = getManuallyPinnedCoreFacts();
      if (coreFacts.length > 0) {
        sections.push('## CORE FACTS (Operator-Pinned — Do Not Contradict)\n' +
          coreFacts.map((f, i) => (i + 1) + '. [' + f.theme + '] ' + f.fact).join('\n'));
        loaded.push('Core Facts (' + coreFacts.length + ')');
      }
    } catch (_) { console.warn('[buildSessionContext] Could not load manually-pinned Core facts'); }

    const block =
      '[🧠 RTP — SESSION CONTEXT INJECTION]\n' +
      'Assembled: ' + new Date().toLocaleString() + '\n' +
      'Active Files: ' + loaded.join(', ') + '\n' +
      'Operator: ' + (props.getProperty(CFG.PROP.OPERATOR_ROLE) || 'Unknown') + '\n' +
      'Onboarding Day: ' + (props.getProperty(CFG.PROP.ONBOARDING_DAY) || '?') +
      ' of ' + CFG.ONBOARDING_DAYS + '\n\n' +
      '═'.repeat(50) + '\n\n' +
      sections.join('\n\n' + '─'.repeat(50) + '\n\n') +
      '\n\n' + '═'.repeat(50) + '\n' +
      '[END CONTEXT INJECTION — Paste this entire block at the top of a new Studio session.]';

    // v8.0: create a doc rather than overwrite getActiveDocument()
    const ts      = Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm');
    const docName = 'SESSION_CONTEXT_' + ts;
    const doc     = DocumentApp.create(docName);
    const dId     = doc.getId();
    doc.getBody().setText(block);
    doc.saveAndClose();

    const rawId = props.getProperty('ID_00_RAW_EXHAUST');
    if (rawId) DriveApp.getFileById(dId).moveTo(DriveApp.getFolderById(rawId));

    const docUrl = DriveApp.getFileById(dId).getUrl();

    ui.alert('✅ Session Context Built',
      'Loaded: ' + loaded.join(', ') + '\n\n' +
      'Doc created: ' + docName + '\n' +
      'URL: ' + docUrl + '\n\n' +
      'Open the doc, copy its contents, and paste at the top of a new Studio session.',
      ui.ButtonSet.OK);

  } catch (e) { _reportError('buildSessionContext', e, ui); }
}


// ================================================================
// SEVEN BRIDGES STIMULUS — HITL WRAPPER
// ================================================================

/**
 * Spreadsheet-menu counterpart to the web app's "Run full council review"
 * button — both are thin surfaces over the same
 * triggerSevenBridgesReview() (6_Governance.gs), which owns the stasis
 * guard, the lock, the council ID, and the document itself.
 *
 * REPLACES generateCouncilInputPayload() (CHANGELOG.md Round 14). That
 * function was an independent re-implementation of the deleted
 * triggerCouncilSimulation()'s shared-context logic — it wrote a doc
 * telling one model to "Act as ARCHITECT, AUDITOR, and MUSE
 * independently" in a single pass, exactly the cross-contamination
 * BRIDGE_FIDELITY_001 forbids, and it was reachable from a live menu
 * item. Rewritten as a delegating wrapper rather than deleted so the
 * operator keeps a working menu path (with its confirm gate) to the
 * sequestered flow.
 *
 * Renders the callee's {success, busy, noop, councilId, message} contract
 * the same way handleCouncil() does in 8_WebApp_UI.html — busy and noop
 * are routine outcomes, not errors, so they get a neutral alert rather
 * than an error one.
 */
function generateSevenBridgesStimulus() {
  const ui = _getUi();
  try {
    // No _coldEngineGate() here — triggerSevenBridgesReview() applies its
    // own TIER_2 gate. Gating twice would just produce a worse error
    // message from the outer call before the real one ever ran.
    const go = ui.alert('Generate Seven Bridges stimulus?',
      'This creates ONE stimulus document from:\n' +
      '  • CURRENT_STATE\n  • PIVOTS_AND_LESSONS\n\n' +
      'You then send that one document to EACH cog independently — a ' +
      'separate Gemini Gem conversation per cog, no shared context ' +
      'between them (BRIDGE_FIDELITY_001) — and log each verdict back ' +
      'under the Council ID it gives you.\n\n' +
      'Nothing reviews it automatically. Continue?',
      ui.ButtonSet.YES_NO);
    if (go !== ui.Button.YES) return;

    const result = triggerSevenBridgesReview();

    if (!result || result.success === false) {
      ui.alert('⚠ Could Not Generate Stimulus',
        (result && result.message) || 'Unknown error.', ui.ButtonSet.OK);
      return;
    }
    if (result.busy || result.noop) {
      // Routine, expected outcomes — same neutral treatment the web app
      // gives them. A "nothing has changed yet" is not a failure.
      ui.alert('Nothing to do', result.message, ui.ButtonSet.OK);
      return;
    }

    // FIXED: the old copy here said "Studio checks for new documents every
    // few minutes and will pick this up automatically." That was never
    // true for this artifact — no STAGING_PIPELINE row is written for it,
    // and the whole point of the sequestered design is that the operator
    // fans the document out by hand. Telling them it was automatic is how
    // a stimulus sits in RAW_EXHAUST forever with no verdicts against it.
    ui.alert('✅ Stimulus Ready — Council ' + result.councilId,
      result.docName + '\n\nSaved to 03.4_RAW_EXHAUST.\n\n' +
      'NEXT — this does not run itself:\n' +
      '  1. Open the doc and read its REVIEW INSTRUCTIONS section.\n' +
      '  2. Send it to each cog in its OWN fresh conversation.\n' +
      '  3. Log every verdict via Ingest → Cog Verdict under Council ID ' +
      result.councilId + '.\n\n' +
      'URL: ' + result.docUrl,
      ui.ButtonSet.OK);

  } catch (e) { _reportError('generateSevenBridgesStimulus', e, ui); }
}


// ================================================================
// PHASE 4 — HITL CHUNK CONSOLIDATION (Legacy Path)
// ================================================================

/**
 * Merges all INTAKE_PROCESSED / PROCESSED chunk docs for the
 * most recent session into a single consolidated document saved
 * to 03.3_PROCESSED_EXHAUST. Updates STAGING_PIPELINE rows to
 * CONSOLIDATED.
 *
 * In the v8.0 headless path, processIntakePayload handles each
 * chunk individually and the Vector Router does live routing.
 * This function is the HITL fallback for manual consolidation.
 */
function consolidateInferenceChunks() {
  const ui = _getUi();
  try {
    const ss      = _getSystemAsset(CFG.INDEX_NAME, 'INDEX_ID', false);
    const staging = _getOrCreateSheet(ss, CFG.STAGING_SHEET);
    const SC      = CFG.STAGING_COLS;
    const data    = staging.getLastRow() > 1
      ? staging.getRange(2, 1, staging.getLastRow() - 1, 7).getValues()
      : [];

    const done = data.filter(r =>
      String(r[SC.STATUS]) === 'INTAKE_PROCESSED' ||
      String(r[SC.STATUS]) === 'PROCESSED'
    );

    if (done.length === 0) {
      ui.alert('No Processed Chunks',
        'No INTAKE_PROCESSED or PROCESSED rows found.\nRun ③ Process Inference Queue first.',
        ui.ButtonSet.OK);
      return;
    }

    const props     = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
    const procId    = props.getProperty('ID_03_3_PROCESSED');
    const procFolder= procId ? DriveApp.getFolderById(procId) : null;
    if (!procFolder) throw new Error('03.3_PROCESSED_EXHAUST folder not found. Run setupRoutingProperties().');

    const ts         = Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss');
    const sessionUID = _generateLogUUID(ts);
    const docName    = '[CONSOLIDATED]_' + sessionUID;
    const outDoc     = DocumentApp.create(docName);
    const outId      = outDoc.getId();
    const outBody    = outDoc.getBody();

    outBody.appendParagraph('CONSOLIDATED SESSION: ' + sessionUID)
           .setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING1);
    outBody.appendParagraph('Assembled: ' + ts);

    let written = 0;
    done.forEach((row, i) => {
      const fileId = String(row[SC.FILE_ID]);
      try {
        const chunkText = DocumentApp.openById(fileId).getBody().getText();
        outBody.appendParagraph('\n── CHUNK ' + (i + 1) + ' ──')
               .setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING3);
        outBody.appendParagraph(chunkText);
        written++;
      } catch (_) {}
    });

    outDoc.saveAndClose();
    DriveApp.getFileById(outId).moveTo(procFolder);

    // Mark staging rows as CONSOLIDATED
    for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
      const s = String(data[i][SC.STATUS]);
      if (s === 'INTAKE_PROCESSED' || s === 'PROCESSED') {
        staging.getRange(i + 2, SC.STATUS + 1).setValue('CONSOLIDATED');
      }
    }
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    ui.alert('✅ Consolidation Complete',
      written + ' chunk(s) merged into:\n' + docName + '\n\n' +
      'Saved to 03.3_PROCESSED_EXHAUST.\n' +
      'URL: ' + DriveApp.getFileById(outId).getUrl(),
      ui.ButtonSet.OK);

  } catch (e) { _reportError('consolidateInferenceChunks', e, ui); }
}

function checkOnboardingProgress() {
  const ui    = _getUi();
  const props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const day   = parseInt(props.getProperty(CFG.PROP.ONBOARDING_DAY)  || '0');
  const armed = props.getProperty(CFG.PROP.THESIS_VERIFIED) === 'true';

  if (!armed) {
    // FIXED (finding #5): "Engine COLD"/"Thesis not verified" is the raw
    // internal state name — the web app's own engine-mode dot already
    // translates this exact state to "Not started" for the same reason.
    // Menu path updated to match this file's onOpen() rename above.
    ui.alert('🔒 Not Started Yet',
      'Setup hasn\'t been completed.\n\nRun 🧠 Admin → Personalize Your Advisor.',
      ui.ButtonSet.OK);
    return;
  }

  const phase = day <= 7  ? '1: Foundation (Days 1–7)' :
                day <= 14 ? '2: Calibration (Days 8–14)' :
                            '3: Activation (Days 15–21)';
  const bar   = '█'.repeat(Math.min(day, 21)) + '░'.repeat(Math.max(0, 21 - day));

  ui.alert('Onboarding Progress — Day ' + day + ' of ' + CFG.ONBOARDING_DAYS,
    '[' + bar + '] ' + Math.round(day / 21 * 100) + '%\n' +
    'Phase: ' + phase + '\n\n' +
    'Role       : ' + (props.getProperty(CFG.PROP.OPERATOR_ROLE)       || 'Not set') + '\n' +
    'Deployment : ' + (props.getProperty(CFG.PROP.DEPLOYMENT_TYPE)     || 'Not set') + '\n\n' +
    '90-Day Vision:\n"' + (props.getProperty(CFG.PROP.VISION_90_DAY)   || 'Not defined') + '"\n\n' +
    'Relational Targets:\n' + (props.getProperty(CFG.PROP.RELATIONAL_TARGETS) || 'Not defined') + '\n\n' +
    '── 3-HORIZON ROI MAP ──\n' +
    'Horizon 1 (90 sec)  Deploy infrastructure          ✔ COMPLETE\n' +
    'Horizon 2 (10 min)  First session ingestion        ' + (day >= 1 ? '✔ COMPLETE' : '○ PENDING') + '\n' +
    'Horizon 3 (21 day)  Full cognitive alignment       ' + (day >= 21 ? '✔ COMPLETE' : day + '/21'),
    ui.ButtonSet.OK);
}


function auditCalibrationHealth() {
  const ui     = _getUi();
  const status = _getCalibrationStatus();
  const props  = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  if (!status.armed) {

    // checkOnboardingProgress()'s equivalent alert above — the
    // "Expected keys" list stays technical on purpose, since this menu
    // item is itself an explicit diagnostic/debug tool.
    ui.alert('⚠ Not Started Yet',
      'No calibration data found.\n\nExpected keys:\n' +
      CFG.CALIBRATION_KEYS.map(k => '  • ' + k).join('\n') +
      '\n\nRun setupCalibration() or Admin → Personalize Your Advisor.',
      ui.ButtonSet.OK);

        (props.getProperty('IDENTITY_KEY') ? '✔ SET' : '⚠ NOT SET')
      : '⚠ PARTIAL — Missing:\n' + missing.map(k => '  • ' + k).join('\n'),
